### File: `input/orbitControls/touchHandlers.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file touchHandlers.js
 * @brief Handles touch interactions, optimized for stable, precision zoom and pan separation.
 */

export function addTouchListeners(controls) {
    controls.canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', controls.onTouchStart.bind(controls), {passive:false});
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', controls.onTouchMove.bind(controls), {passive:false});
    window.addEventListener('touchend', controls.onTouchEnd.bind(controls));
}

// B"H - Touch States
const STATE = {
    NONE: 0,
    ROTATE: 1,
    PAN_ZOOM_DECIDE: 2,
    PAN: 3,
    ZOOM: 4
};

export function onTouchStartHandler(controls, e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if(e.touches.length === 1) {
        controls.touchState = STATE.ROTATE;
        controls.lastX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        controls.lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        controls.touchState = STATE.PAN_ZOOM_DECIDE;
        
        // Initial center
        controls.lastX = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
        controls.lastY = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
        
        // Initial distance
        const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
        const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
        controls.initialPinchDistance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        
        controls.initialPanCenter = [controls.lastX, controls.lastY];
    }
}

export function onTouchMoveHandler(controls, e) {
    if (controls.touchState === STATE.ROTATE && e.touches.length === 1) {
        const x = e.touches[0].clientX;
        const y = e.touches[0].clientY;
        controls.handleRotate(x - controls.lastX, y - controls.lastY);
        controls.lastX = x; controls.lastY = y;
        
    } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        const centerX = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
        const centerY = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
        
        const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
        const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
        const currentDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        // B"H - Divine Decision Logic
        if (controls.touchState === STATE.PAN_ZOOM_DECIDE) {
            const distDelta = Math.abs(currentDist - controls.initialPinchDistance);
            const panDx = centerX - controls.initialPanCenter[0];
            const panDy = centerY - controls.initialPanCenter[1];
            const panDist = Math.sqrt(panDx*panDx + panDy*panDy);
            
            const THRESHOLD = 10; // Pixels
            
            if (distDelta > THRESHOLD && distDelta > panDist) {
                controls.touchState = STATE.ZOOM;
                controls.initialPinchDistance = currentDist; // Reset base to prevent jump
            } else if (panDist > THRESHOLD) {
                controls.touchState = STATE.PAN;
                controls.lastX = centerX; // Reset base
                controls.lastY = centerY;
            }
        }

        if (controls.touchState === STATE.ZOOM) {
            if (controls.initialPinchDistance > 0) { 
                const zoomDelta = (currentDist - controls.initialPinchDistance);
                const cam = controls.camera;
                cam.state.radius -= zoomDelta * 0.4; 
                cam.state.radius = Math.max(0.1, cam.state.radius);
                cam.state.isDirty = true;
                controls.initialPinchDistance = currentDist; 
            }
        } else if (controls.touchState === STATE.PAN) {
            controls.handlePan(centerX - controls.lastX, centerY - controls.lastY);
            controls.lastX = centerX; controls.lastY = centerY;
        }
    }
}

export function onTouchEndHandler(controls) {
    controls.touchState = STATE.NONE;
    controls.initialPinchDistance = 0; 
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file transformations.js
 * @brief Sacred translation of 2D mouse movements into 3D orbital mechanics.
 */

export function handleRotateFn(controls, dx, dy) {
    const cam = controls.camera;
    // B"H - Invert Y axis for natural rotation
    cam.state.alpha -= dx * controls.rotateSpeed; 
    cam.state.beta += dy * controls.rotateSpeed;  
    
    // B"H - Clamp elevation to avoid flipping the universe upside down
    const limit = Math.PI / 2 - 0.05;
    cam.state.beta = Math.max(-limit, Math.min(limit, cam.state.beta));
    cam.state.isDirty = true;
}

export function handlePanFn(controls, dx, dy) {
    const cam = controls.camera;
    const alpha = cam.state.alpha;
    const beta = cam.state.beta;

    // B"H - THE TIKKUN OF PANNING:
    // We must calculate the exact Local Right and Local Up vectors of the camera
    // to ensure panning matches the screen regardless of how far down we look!

    // 1. Local Right Vector (Perpendicular to Forward and World Up)
    const rightX = Math.cos(alpha);
    const rightZ = -Math.sin(alpha);

    // 2. Local Up Vector (Cross product of Right and Forward)
    const upX = -Math.sin(alpha) * Math.sin(beta);
    const upY = Math.cos(beta);
    const upZ = -Math.cos(alpha) * Math.sin(beta);
    
    const panFactor = controls.panSpeed * (cam.state.radius / 10.0); 

    // 3. Apply exact spatial movement
    cam.state.target[0] -= rightX * dx * panFactor;
    cam.state.target[0] += upX * dy * panFactor;
    
    cam.state.target[1] += upY * dy * panFactor; 
    
    cam.state.target[2] -= rightZ * dx * panFactor; 
    cam.state.target[2] += upZ * dy * panFactor;
    
    cam.state.isDirty = true;
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file mouseHandlers.js
 * @chapter THE DISTINCTION OF WILL
 */

export function addMouseListeners(controls) {
    controls.canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', controls.onMouseDown.bind(controls));
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', controls.onMouseMove.bind(controls));
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', controls.onMouseUp.bind(controls)); 
    controls.canvas.addEventListener('wheel', controls.onMouseWheel.bind(controls), {passive:false});
    window.addEventListener('keydown', controls.onKeyDown.bind(controls));
    window.addEventListener('keyup', controls.onKeyUp.bind(controls));
}

export function onMouseDownHandler(controls, e) {
    // B"H - If the TransformController has claimed this click, we must bow out!
    if (window.__IS_DRAGGING_OBJECT__) return;

    e.preventDefault(); 
    controls.lastX = e.clientX;
    controls.lastY = e.clientY;
    controls.activeButton = e.button; 
    
    const isPlayMode = controls.renderer && controls.renderer.isPlaying;

    if (e.button === 1 || e.shiftKey || (e.button === 2 && !isPlayMode)) {
        controls.isPanning = true;
        controls.isDragging = false;
    } 
    else if (e.button === 0 || (e.button === 2 && isPlayMode)) {
        controls.isDragging = true;
        controls.isPanning = false;
    }

    controls.isDualClicking = ((e.buttons & 1) && (e.buttons & 2));
}

export function onMouseMoveHandler(controls, e) {
    // B"H - Maintain silence during creation
    if (window.__IS_DRAGGING_OBJECT__) return;

    const dx = e.clientX - controls.lastX;
    const dy = e.clientY - controls.lastY;
    controls.lastX = e.clientX;
    controls.lastY = e.clientY;

    if (controls.isPanning) {
        controls.handlePan(dx, dy);
    } else if (controls.isDragging) {
        controls.handleRotate(dx, dy);
    }
}

export function onMouseUpHandler(controls, e) {
    controls.isDragging = false;
    controls.isPanning = false;
    controls.activeButton = -1;
    controls.isDualClicking = false;
}

export function onMouseWheelHandler(controls, e) {
    e.preventDefault(); 
    const cam = controls.camera;
    if (cam.state.targetRadius === undefined || isNaN(cam.state.targetRadius)) {
        cam.state.targetRadius = cam.state.radius;
    }
    const zoomFactor = 1.15; 
    if (e.deltaY > 0) cam.state.targetRadius *= zoomFactor;
    else cam.state.targetRadius /= zoomFactor;
    
    cam.state.targetRadius = Math.max(1.5, Math.min(cam.state.targetRadius, 300.0));
    if (!controls.renderer || !controls.renderer.isPlaying) cam.state.radius = cam.state.targetRadius;
    cam.state.isDirty = true;
}

export function onKeyDownHandler(controls, e) {
    if (e.key === 'Shift') controls.isShiftKeyDown = true;
}

export function onKeyUpHandler(controls, e) {
    if (e.key === 'Shift') controls.isShiftKeyDown = false;
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file blender.js
 * @brief Dynamic weighting and TIME CONTROL for skeletal states.
 */

export class PlayerAnimationBlender {
    constructor(renderer) {
        this.renderer = renderer;
        this.weights = { walk: 0, fall: 0, idle: 1 };
        this.lerpSpeed = 12.0; 
        
        this.walkTime = 0;
    }

    update(state, dt, playerId) {
        const { speed, onGround, velocityY, zIntent } = state;
        
        let tWalk = 0, tFall = 0, tIdle = 0;

        if (!onGround) {
            tFall = 1.0; 
            tWalk = 0.0;
            tIdle = 0.0;
        } else {
            tFall = 0.0;
            tWalk = Math.min(1.0, speed / 4.0); 
            if (tWalk < 0.1) tWalk = 0;
            tIdle = 1.0 - tWalk;
        }

        this.weights.walk += (tWalk - this.weights.walk) * this.lerpSpeed * dt;
        this.weights.fall += (tFall - this.weights.fall) * this.lerpSpeed * dt;
        this.weights.idle += (tIdle - this.weights.idle) * this.lerpSpeed * dt;

        // B"H - THE TIKKUN OF TIME: Invert zIntent to reverse the flow of the walk cycle!
        // Forward (zIntent=1) becomes -1 (plays backward). Backward (zIntent=-1) becomes 1 (plays forward).
        const direction = (zIntent !== 0) ? -zIntent : -1.0;
        this.walkTime += dt * speed * 0.12 * direction;

        const am = this.renderer.animationManager;
        const config = am.objectAnimations[playerId];
        if (!config) return;

        config.forEach(c => {
            const track = c.track;
            if (track.startsWith('walk_')) {
                c.weight = this.weights.walk;
                c.speed = 0; 
                c.offset = this.walkTime; 
            }
            else if (track.startsWith('idle_')) {
                c.weight = this.weights.idle;
                c.speed = 1.0; 
                c.offset = 0;
            }
            else if (track.startsWith('fall_')) {
                c.weight = this.weights.fall;
                c.speed = 1.0;
                c.offset = 0;
            }
            else if (track.startsWith('jump_')) {
                c.weight = (!onGround && velocityY > 2.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
            }
        });
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
import { Vec3 } from '../../../core/math/vec3.js';
import { SpatialMath } from '../../../core/physics/spatial/math.js';

export class CollisionResolver {
    constructor() {
        this.radius = 0.85; 
        
        // B"H - THE TRUE GEOMETRIC MEASUREMENTS
        // The Golem's mathematical origin [0,0,0] is the center of the torso.
        // Hips are at -1.5. Legs extrude down by 3.8. 
        // Therefore, feet are exactly 5.3 units below the origin.
        this.footOffset = 5.3; 
        
        this.slopeLimit = 0.55; 
        this.groundBuffer = 0.6; 
    }

    resolve(oldPos, nextPos, velocity, colliders) {
        let finalPos = [...nextPos];
        let grounded = false;

        if (!colliders || colliders.length === 0) return { pos: finalPos, grounded: false };

        // 1. PROJECTING THE VESSEL (Wall Expulsion)
        // We place spheres spanning the entire 8-unit tall body to push it out of walls.
        const spheres =[
            [finalPos[0], finalPos[1] - 4.2, finalPos[2]], // Shins/Knees
            [finalPos[0], finalPos[1] - 1.0, finalPos[2]], // Pelvis
            [finalPos[0], finalPos[1] + 1.5, finalPos[2]]  // Chest
        ];

        for (let iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
            let collision = false;
            
            for (const collider of colliders) {
                const octree = collider.octree;
                if (!octree) continue;

                // Query a large radius to encompass the tall character
                const tris = octree.querySphere(finalPos, 6.0);
                
                for (const triIdx of tris) {
                    const v0 = octree.getVertex(octree.indices[triIdx * 3]);
                    const v1 = octree.getVertex(octree.indices[triIdx * 3 + 1]);
                    const v2 = octree.getVertex(octree.indices[triIdx * 3 + 2]);

                    for (let s = 0; s < spheres.length; s++) {
                        const cp = spheres[s];
                        const closest = SpatialMath.closestPointOnTriangle(cp, v0, v1, v2);
                        const diff = Vec3.sub(cp, closest);
                        const d2 = Vec3.dot(diff, diff);
                        
                        if (d2 < this.radius * this.radius && d2 > 1e-10) {
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
                            const push = (this.radius - dist);
                            const n = Vec3.scale(diff, 1 / dist);
                            
                            finalPos[0] += n[0] * push;
                            finalPos[1] += n[1] * push;
                            finalPos[2] += n[2] * push;
                            
                            // Prevent climbing ceilings
                            if (n[1] < -0.5 && velocity[1] > 0) velocity[1] = 0;

                            const pushVec = Vec3.scale(n, push);
                            spheres[0] = Vec3.add(spheres[0], pushVec);
                            spheres[1] = Vec3.add(spheres[1], pushVec);
                            spheres[2] = Vec3.add(spheres[2], pushVec);

                            collision = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!collision) break;
        }

        // 2. THE SACRED GROUND SNAP (Finding the highest floor)
        // Start the raycast from the highest point (old or new) to prevent tunneling 
        // through the floor if we fell extremely fast.
        const highestY = Math.max(oldPos[1], finalPos[1]);
        const rayStart = [finalPos[0], highestY + 3.0, finalPos[2]]; 
        let bestFloorY = -Infinity;
        let hitFloor = false;

        for (const collider of colliders) {
            const octree = collider.octree;
            if (!octree) continue;

            const hit = octree.raycast(rayStart,[0, -1, 0]);
            
            // Check if the surface points upwards (is walkable)
            if (hit && hit.normal[1] > this.slopeLimit) {
                if (hit.point[1] > bestFloorY) {
                    bestFloorY = hit.point[1];
                    hitFloor = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (hitFloor) {
            // B"H - Since feet are exactly 5.3 units below the center, 
            // the ideal pivot center is 5.3 units ABOVE the floor!
            const idealPivotY = bestFloorY + this.footOffset;
            const pivotDist = finalPos[1] - idealPivotY;

            // Snap down to floor if hovering slightly, OR snap UP if buried.
            // A deep negative buffer (-20.0) ensures if the engine lags and 
            // drops us far underground, we are teleported instantly back to the surface.
            if (pivotDist < this.groundBuffer && pivotDist > -20.0) {
                grounded = true;
                
                // Only arrest vertical momentum if we are falling or resting.
                if (velocity[1] <= 1e-2) {
                    finalPos[1] = idealPivotY;
                    velocity[1] = 0; 
                }
            }
        }

        return { pos: finalPos, grounded };
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file visuals.js
 * @brief Aligns the visual geometry smoothly to match the physical trajectory.
 */

export function updateVisualRotation(controller, xIntent, zIntent, dt) {
    let targetVisRot = controller.rotationY;
    
    // If moving, face the direction of the combined vector
    if (xIntent !== 0 || zIntent !== 0) {
        const localAngle = Math.atan2(xIntent, zIntent); 
        targetVisRot = controller.rotationY + localAngle;
    }

    // Smoothly interpolate the mesh rotation
    let rotDiff = targetVisRot - controller.visualRotationY;
    
    // Normalize to [-PI, PI] to take the shortest path
    rotDiff = Math.atan2(Math.sin(rotDiff), Math.cos(rotDiff)); 
    
    controller.visualRotationY += rotDiff * 12.0 * dt;
    
    return controller.visualRotationY;
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file movement.js
 * @brief Translates keystrokes into spatial translation vectors.
 */

export function calculateMovementIntent(controller, dt, input) {
    let zIntent = 0;
    let xIntent = 0;

    if (input.keys.left) controller.rotationY += 3.8 * dt;
    if (input.keys.right) controller.rotationY -= 3.8 * dt;
    
    if (input.keys.forward) zIntent = 1;
    if (input.keys.backward) zIntent = -1;
    if (input.keys.strafeLeft) xIntent = -1;
    if (input.keys.strafeRight) xIntent = 1;

    return { xIntent, zIntent };
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file steering.js
 * @brief Translates mouse draggings into angular intent for the player.
 */

export function handleSteering(controller, dt, orbit, cam) {
    const isRightClickDragging = orbit && (orbit.isDragging || orbit.isPanning) && orbit.activeButton === 2;

    if (isRightClickDragging) {
        let targetRot = cam.state.alpha + Math.PI;
        
        while(targetRot - controller.rotationY > Math.PI) targetRot -= Math.PI * 2;
        while(targetRot - controller.rotationY < -Math.PI) targetRot += Math.PI * 2;
        
        controller.rotationY += (targetRot - controller.rotationY) * 15.0 * dt;
        controller.camera.lastPlayerRotY = controller.rotationY; 

        // Dual clicking acts as auto-forward
        if (orbit.isDualClicking) return 1; // zIntent
    }
    return 0; // default zIntent
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file integrator.js
 * @brief Dynamic transit physics.
 */
import { Vec3 } from '../../../core/math/vec3.js';

export class PlayerPhysicsIntegrator {
    constructor() {
        this.velocity = [0, 0, 0];
        this.accel = 160.0; 
        this.drag = 10.0;
        this.maxSpeed = 22.0;
        this.gravity = 65.0; // Increased to ensure groundedness
        this.jumpImpulse = 26.0;
    }

    /**
     * B"H - Applies horizontal will.
     */
    applyInput(moveDir, dt, onGround) {
        const mult = onGround ? 1.0 : 0.3; // Less air control
        
        this.velocity[0] += moveDir[0] * this.accel * mult * dt;
        this.velocity[2] += moveDir[2] * this.accel * mult * dt;

        // Apply Friction
        const damping = onGround ? this.drag : (this.drag * 0.1);
        this.velocity[0] *= Math.max(0, 1.0 - damping * dt);
        this.velocity[2] *= Math.max(0, 1.0 - damping * dt);

        // Limit Speed
        const hS2 = this.velocity[0]**2 + this.velocity[2]**2;
        if (hS2 > this.maxSpeed**2) {
            const r = this.maxSpeed / Math.sqrt(hS2);
            this.velocity[0] *= r; this.velocity[2] *= r;
        }
    }

    /**
     * B"H - Applies gravity to a weightless soul.
     */
    applyGravity(dt, onGround) {
        if (onGround) {
            // Ground stops downward momentum instantly
            if (this.velocity[1] < 0) this.velocity[1] = 0;
        } else {
            this.velocity[1] -= this.gravity * dt;
            // Termina velocity
            if (this.velocity[1] < -90) this.velocity[1] = -90;
        }
    }

    jump() {
        this.velocity[1] = this.jumpImpulse;
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file playerController.js
 * @chapter THE UNIFICATION OF MOTION
 */
import { PlayerPhysicsIntegrator } from './physics/integrator.js';
import { CollisionResolver } from './collision/resolver.js';
import { PlayerAnimationBlender } from './animation/blender.js';
import { AyinCamera } from '../camera/ayinCamera.js';

import { handleSteering } from './controller/steering.js';
import { calculateMovementIntent } from './controller/movement.js';
import { updateVisualRotation } from './controller/visuals.js';

export class PlayerController {
    constructor(renderer, inputManager) {
        this.renderer = renderer;
        this.input = inputManager;
        this.physics = new PlayerPhysicsIntegrator();
        this.collision = new CollisionResolver();
        this.animation = new PlayerAnimationBlender(renderer);
        this.camera = new AyinCamera(renderer);

        this.playerObj = null;
        this.rotationY = 0; 
        this.visualRotationY = 0; 
        this.onGround = false;
    }

    setPlayerObject(obj) {
        this.playerObj = obj;
        if(obj.keyframes && obj.keyframes[0]) {
            this.rotationY = obj.keyframes[0].rotation[1] || 0;
            this.visualRotationY = this.rotationY;
        }
    }

    update(dt) {
        if (!this.playerObj || !this.input) return;

        const colliders = this.renderer?.systemManager?.rigidBodySystem?.staticColliders ||[];
        const kf = this.playerObj.keyframes[0];
        const oldPos = [...kf.position];
        
        const cam = this.renderer.camera;
        const orbit = this.renderer.orbitControls;

        // 1. Steering & Input
        let mouseZIntent = handleSteering(this, dt, orbit, cam);
        const { xIntent, zIntent: keyZIntent } = calculateMovementIntent(this, dt, this.input);
        
        const zIntent = mouseZIntent || keyZIntent;

        // 2. Physics Integration
        let moveDir =[
            Math.sin(this.rotationY) * zIntent + Math.cos(this.rotationY) * xIntent, 
            0, 
            Math.cos(this.rotationY) * zIntent - Math.sin(this.rotationY) * xIntent
        ];

        const moveMag = Math.sqrt(moveDir[0]**2 + moveDir[2]**2);
        if (moveMag > 1.0) {
            moveDir[0] /= moveMag;
            moveDir[2] /= moveMag;
        }

        this.physics.applyInput(moveDir, dt, this.onGround);
        if (this.input.keys.jump && this.onGround) {
            this.physics.jump();
            this.onGround = false;
        }
        this.physics.applyGravity(dt, this.onGround);

        let nextPos =[
            oldPos[0] + this.physics.velocity[0] * dt,
            oldPos[1] + this.physics.velocity[1] * dt,
            oldPos[2] + this.physics.velocity[2] * dt
        ];

        // 3. Collision Resolution
        if (colliders.length > 0) {
            const res = this.collision.resolve(oldPos, nextPos, this.physics.velocity, colliders);
            kf.position = res.pos;
            this.onGround = res.grounded;
        } else {
            if (nextPos[1] < 5.3) {
                nextPos[1] = 5.3;
                this.physics.velocity[1] = 0;
                this.onGround = true;
            } else this.onGround = false;
            kf.position = nextPos;
        }

        // 4. Visuals & Animation
        const visY = updateVisualRotation(this, xIntent, zIntent, dt);
        kf.rotation =[0, visY, 0];
        
        this.camera.update(kf.position, this.rotationY, colliders, dt);
        
        const speed = Math.sqrt(this.physics.velocity[0]**2 + this.physics.velocity[2]**2);
        const isWalking = (speed > 0.5);
        const animZIntent = isWalking ? 1 : 0; 

        this.animation.update({ speed, onGround: this.onGround, velocityY: this.physics.velocity[1], zIntent: animZIntent }, dt, this.playerObj.id);

        if (kf.position[1] < -350) {
            kf.position =[0, 200, 0];
            this.physics.velocity =[0,0,0];
        }
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
import { PLAYER_CONFIG } from './config.js';
import { Vec3 } from '../../core/math/vec3.js';

export class PlayerCamera {
    constructor(renderer) {
        this.renderer = renderer;
        this.config = PLAYER_CONFIG;
    }

    update(playerPos, rotationY, octree) {
        const cam = this.renderer.camera;
        const s = cam.state;
        
        // Target: Player Head
        const tX = playerPos[0];
        const tY = playerPos[1] + 4.0; // Look at head height
        const tZ = playerPos[2];

        // Smooth Target Follow
        s.target[0] += (tX - s.target[0]) * this.config.camSmooth;
        s.target[1] += (tY - s.target[1]) * this.config.camSmooth;
        s.target[2] += (tZ - s.target[2]) * this.config.camSmooth;
        
        // Rotation Follow (Laggy)
        const desiredAlpha = rotationY + Math.PI; // Behind player
        let alphaDiff = desiredAlpha - s.alpha;
        
        // Normalize angle
        while (alphaDiff > Math.PI) alphaDiff -= Math.PI * 2;
        while (alphaDiff < -Math.PI) alphaDiff += Math.PI * 2;
        
        s.alpha += alphaDiff * 0.05;
        s.beta = 0.25; // Fixed pitch for now
        s.radius = this.config.camDist;

        // Camera Collision (Raycast from target to desired cam pos)
        if (octree) {
            this.preventOcclusion(s, octree);
        }

        s.isDirty = true;
    }

    preventOcclusion(state, octree) {
        // Calculate where camera WANTS to be based on spherical coords
        const eyex = state.target[0] + state.radius * Math.cos(state.beta) * Math.sin(state.alpha);
        const eyey = state.target[1] + state.radius * Math.sin(state.beta);
        const eyez = state.target[2] + state.radius * Math.cos(state.beta) * Math.cos(state.alpha);
        
        const origin = state.target;
        const desiredPos = [eyex, eyey, eyez];
        
        const dir = Vec3.sub(desiredPos, origin);
        const dist = Math.sqrt(Vec3.dot(dir, dir));
        
        if (dist < 0.001) return;

        const normDir = Vec3.scale(dir, 1/dist);
        
        // Raycast from Head to Camera
        const hit = octree.raycast(origin, normDir);
        
        // If we hit something closer than the camera
        if (hit && hit.distance < dist) {
            // Pull camera in, minus a collision radius buffer
            state.radius = Math.max(1.0, hit.distance - this.config.camCollisionRadius);
        }
    }
}
```

### File: `input/player/collision.js`

```
// B"H
import { Vec3 } from '../../core/math/vec3.js';
import { SpatialMath } from '../../core/physics/spatial/math.js';
import { Capsule } from '../../core/physics/colliders/capsule.js';
import { PLAYER_CONFIG } from './config.js';

export class CollisionSystem {
    constructor() {
        this.capsule = new Capsule([0,0,0], [0,1,0], PLAYER_CONFIG.radius);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves capsule collisions with the static mesh octree.
     * @param {Array} pos - Current player feet position.
     * @param {Array} velocity - Current velocity (to modify if grounded).
     * @param {Octree} octree - The world geometry.
     * @returns {Object} - { pos, grounded }
     */
    resolve(pos, velocity, octree) {
        // Update capsule to current position
        this.capsule.setFromPosition(pos, PLAYER_CONFIG.height, PLAYER_CONFIG.radius);
        
        // 1. Broadphase: Sphere Query around the whole capsule
        const center = this.capsule.getCenter();
        const totalHeight = PLAYER_CONFIG.height;
        const queryRadius = totalHeight; 
        
        const tris = octree.querySphere(center, queryRadius);
        
        let grounded = false;

        // 2. Narrowphase: Iterate triangles and push out
        // Multiple iterations for stability (solver style)
        for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
            let collisionOccurred = false;
            
            for (const triIdx of tris) {
                const i0 = octree.indices[triIdx * 3];
                const i1 = octree.indices[triIdx * 3 + 1];
                const i2 = octree.indices[triIdx * 3 + 2];
                
                const v0 = octree.getVertex(i0);
                const v1 = octree.getVertex(i1);
                const v2 = octree.getVertex(i2);

                // Check 3 key points on the capsule axis against the triangle
                const pointsToCheck = [this.capsule.base, this.capsule.top, this.capsule.getCenter()];
                
                for (const pt of pointsToCheck) {
                    const closest = SpatialMath.closestPointOnTriangle(pt, v0, v1, v2);
                    const vec = Vec3.sub(pt, closest);
                    const distSq = Vec3.dot(vec, vec);
                    
                    if (distSq < this.capsule.radius * this.capsule.radius) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
                        const pushLen = this.capsule.radius - dist;
                        const pushDir = (dist > 0.0001) ? Vec3.scale(vec, 1/dist) : [0,1,0];
                        
                        // Apply push
                        pos = Vec3.add(pos, Vec3.scale(pushDir, pushLen));
                        
                        // Re-update capsule for next check within this frame
                        this.capsule.setFromPosition(pos, PLAYER_CONFIG.height, PLAYER_CONFIG.radius);
                        
                        collisionOccurred = true;
                        
                        // Check if ground (slope check)
                        // If the push is upward, we are standing on something
                        if (pushDir[1] > PLAYER_CONFIG.slopeLimit) {
                            grounded = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!collisionOccurred) break;
        }
        
        return { pos, grounded };
    }
}
```

### File: `input/player/physics.js`

```
// B"H
import { PLAYER_CONFIG } from './config.js';

export class PlayerPhysics {
    constructor() {
        this.velocity = [0, 0, 0];
        this.onGround = false;
    }

    applyInput(moveDir, dt) {
        const { acceleration, friction, airResistance, maxSpeed } = PLAYER_CONFIG;
        
        // Acceleration
        const accel = this.onGround ? acceleration : (acceleration * 0.2); 
        this.velocity[0] += moveDir[0] * accel * dt;
        this.velocity[2] += moveDir[2] * accel * dt;

        // Friction
        const damping = this.onGround ? friction : airResistance;
        this.velocity[0] *= Math.max(0, 1.0 - damping * dt);
        this.velocity[2] *= Math.max(0, 1.0 - damping * dt);

        // Cap Horizontal Speed
        const hSpeed = Math.sqrt(this.velocity[0]**2 + this.velocity[2]**2);
        if (hSpeed > maxSpeed) {
            const ratio = maxSpeed / hSpeed;
            this.velocity[0] *= ratio;
            this.velocity[2] *= ratio;
        }
    }

    applyGravity(dt) {
        this.velocity[1] -= PLAYER_CONFIG.gravity * dt;
        this.velocity[1] = Math.max(this.velocity[1], -50.0); // Terminal velocity
    }

    jump() {
        if (this.onGround) {
            this.velocity[1] = PLAYER_CONFIG.jumpForce;
            this.onGround = false;
        }
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file inputManager.js
 * @chapter THE BARRIER OF THE VOID
 */

export class InputManager {
    constructor() {
        this.keys = { 
            forward: false, backward: false, left: false, right: false, 
            strafeLeft: false, strafeRight: false, 
            run: false, jump: false 
        };
        this._boundDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
        this._boundUp = this._onKeyUp.bind(this);
    }

    enable() {
        window.addEventListener('keydown', this._boundDown, { capture: true });
        window.addEventListener('keyup', this._boundUp, { capture: true });
    }

    disable() {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._boundDown, { capture: true });
        window.removeEventListener('keyup', this._boundUp, { capture: true });
        Object.keys(this.keys).forEach(k => this.keys[k] = false);
    }

    _onKeyDown(e) {
        const k = e.code;
        
        if (k === 'Space' || k.startsWith('Arrow')) {
            if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
                document.activeElement.blur();
            }
            if (e.target.tagName !== 'INPUT' && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') {
                e.preventDefault(); 
            }
        }

        if (k === 'KeyW' || k === 'ArrowUp') this.keys.forward = true;
        if (k === 'KeyS' || k === 'ArrowDown') this.keys.backward = true;
        if (k === 'KeyA' || k === 'ArrowLeft') this.keys.left = true;
        if (k === 'KeyD' || k === 'ArrowRight') this.keys.right = true;
        
        // B"H - Swapped Keys
        if (k === 'KeyQ') this.keys.strafeRight = true;  
        if (k === 'KeyE') this.keys.strafeLeft = true;  

        if (k === 'ShiftLeft' || k === 'ShiftRight') this.keys.run = true;
        if (k === 'Space') this.keys.jump = true;
    }

    _onKeyUp(e) {
        const k = e.code;
        if (k === 'KeyW' || k === 'ArrowUp') this.keys.forward = false;
        if (k === 'KeyS' || k === 'ArrowDown') this.keys.backward = false;
        if (k === 'KeyA' || k === 'ArrowLeft') this.keys.left = false;
        if (k === 'KeyD' || k === 'ArrowRight') this.keys.right = false;
        
        // B"H - Swapped Keys
        if (k === 'KeyQ') this.keys.strafeRight = false; 
        if (k === 'KeyE') this.keys.strafeLeft = false; 

        if (k === 'ShiftLeft' || k === 'ShiftRight') this.keys.run = false;
        if (k === 'Space') this.keys.jump = false;
    }

    isMoving() { 
        return this.keys.forward || this.keys.backward || this.keys.left || this.keys.right || this.keys.strafeLeft || this.keys.strafeRight; 
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file input.js
 * @brief Orchestrates the receiving of the Divine Command (User Input).
 */

import { HTML } from '../../../../html-generator.js';
import { EternalConsoleState } from './state/eternalState.js';
import { ConsoleDOMCache } from './dom/domCache.js';
import { CONSOLE_INPUT_SCHEMA } from './input/inputSchema.js';
import { DevToolsBridge } from '../../bridge.js';
import VirtualizedEditor from '/scripts/awtsmoos/coding/pnimi.js';

export const ConsoleInput = {
    attach(parentContainer, state, logFn) {
        EternalConsoleState.sync(state);

        if (ConsoleDOMCache.inputArea) {
            parentContainer.appendChild(ConsoleDOMCache.inputArea);
            if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance) {
                setTimeout(() => ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.refresh(), 50);
            }
            this._bindButtons(ConsoleDOMCache.inputArea, state);
            return;
        }

        const area = HTML(CONSOLE_INPUT_SCHEMA);
        parentContainer.appendChild(area);
        const inputEl = area.querySelector('#dt-console-text-entry');
        
        let historyIndex = -1;

        // B"H - Binding Logic
        inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const code = e.target.value.trim();
                
                if (code) {
                    const logObj = { 
                        level: 'input', 
                        args: [{ type: 'string', value: code, forceCode: true }],
                        timestamp: Date.now()
                    };
                    
                    EternalConsoleState.addLog(logObj);
                    EternalConsoleState.addToHistory(code);
                    historyIndex = -1;
                    
                    // Render immediately
                    logFn(logObj);
                    
                    DevToolsBridge.sendEval(EternalConsoleState.getPreviewTabId(), code);
                    
                    if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance) {
                        ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.update("");
                    }
                    e.target.value = "";
                    inputEl.style.height = '24px';
                }
            }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const hist = EternalConsoleState.getHistory();
                if (hist.length === 0) return;
                
                if (historyIndex === -1) historyIndex = hist.length - 1;
                else historyIndex = Math.max(0, historyIndex - 1);
                
                const prevCmd = hist[historyIndex];
                e.target.value = prevCmd;
                
                // B"H - Tikkun: Force refresh of highlighter
                if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance) {
                    ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.update(prevCmd);
                    ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.refresh();
                }
            }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const hist = EternalConsoleState.getHistory();
                
                if (historyIndex === -1 || historyIndex === hist.length - 1) {
                    historyIndex = -1;
                    e.target.value = "";
                    if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance) {
                        ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.update("");
                        ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.refresh();
                    }
                } else {
                    historyIndex = Math.min(hist.length - 1, historyIndex + 1);
                    const nextCmd = hist[historyIndex];
                    e.target.value = nextCmd;
                    if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance) {
                        ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.update(nextCmd);
                        ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.refresh();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        inputEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
            inputEl.style.height = 'auto'; 
            const newHeight = inputEl.scrollHeight;
            inputEl.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
            if (ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance && ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.wrapper) {
                ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.wrapper.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
                ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance.refresh();
            }
        });

        try {
            const ve = new VirtualizedEditor(inputEl, 'js');
            ConsoleDOMCache.editorInstance = ve;
            if (ve.wrapper) {
                ve.wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                ve.wrapper.style.height = '24px';
            }
        } catch(e) {
            inputEl.style.color = '#fff';
        }

        ConsoleDOMCache.inputArea = area;
        this._bindButtons(area, state);
        setTimeout(() => inputEl.focus(), 150);
    },
    
    _bindButtons(area, state) {
        const upBtn = area.querySelector('#dt-console-history-up');
        const clearBtn = area.querySelector('#dt-console-clear');
        const inputEl = area.querySelector('#dt-console-text-entry');
        
        if (upBtn) {
            upBtn.onclick = () => {
                inputEl.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowUp' }));
                inputEl.focus();
            };
        }
        
        if (clearBtn) {
            clearBtn.onclick = () => {
                state.logs.length = 0;
                if (ConsoleDOMCache.logContainer) {
                    ConsoleDOMCache.logContainer.innerHTML = '';
                }
            };
        }
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file code-block.js
 * @brief The Ark of the Code.
 */

import { HTML } from '../../../../html-generator.js';
import VirtualizedEditor from '/scripts/awtsmoos/coding/pnimi.js';
import { VisibilityObserver } from '../../../common/observer.js';

export const CodeBlockRenderer = {
    render(content, lang) {
        const editorContainer = HTML({
            tag: 'div',
            className: 'dt-el-code-block',
            style: { 
                paddingLeft: '20px', 
                margin: '5px 0', 
                borderLeft: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
                minHeight: '20px'
            },
            children:[
                {
                    tag: 'textarea',
                    readOnly: true,
                    value: content,
                    style: {
                        width: '100%',
                        background: 'transparent',
                        border: 'none',
                        resize: 'none',
                        color: 'transparent',
                        fontFamily: 'var(--font-code)',
                        fontSize: '13px',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        padding: 0,
                        margin: 0,
                        whiteSpace: 'pre',
                        display: 'block'
                    }
                }
            ]
        });

        // B"H - Delay to ensure DOM insertion
        setTimeout(() => {
            const ta = editorContainer.querySelector('textarea');
            if(ta) {
                const lines = content.split('\n').length;
                const height = Math.min(lines * 18 + 10, 400); // Dynamic height calculation
                ta.style.height = `${height}px`;
                if(lines > 20) ta.style.overflow = 'auto';

                try {
                    const ve = new VirtualizedEditor(ta, lang);
                    ve.wrapper.style.height = `${height}px`;
                    if(ve.overlay) ve.overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                    
                    // Expose it to the HTML element so the expander can call refresh()
                    editorContainer._awtsmoosEditor = ve;
                    
                    // Force the text into the worker immediately
                    ve.update(content);
                    
                    VisibilityObserver.observe(editorContainer, ve);
                } catch(e) {
                    console.warn("Element Code Highlight Failed", e);
                }
            }
        }, 50);

        return editorContainer;
    }
};
```

### File: `js/devtools/open.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file open.js
 * @brief Logic for targeting and opening DevTools.
 */

import { State } from '../state.js';
import { Tabs } from '../tabs/index.js';

export const DevToolsOpener = {
    /**
     * B"H - Opens the DevTools vision for a specific tab or the current active preview.
     */
    async open(item) {
        let previewTab = null;

        // 1. Try to determine the target preview tab from the input item
        if (item) {
            // Case A: The item is the Preview Tab itself
            const tabByItem = State.tabs.find(t => t.item === item || (t.item.path === item.path && t.item.workspaceId === item.workspaceId));
            
            if (tabByItem && (tabByItem.isPreview || tabByItem.fileType === 'html-preview')) {
                previewTab = tabByItem;
            } 
            // Case B: The item is a Source File, search for its preview
            else {
                previewTab = State.tabs.find(t => 
                    (t.isPreview || t.fileType === 'html-preview') && 
                    t.item.path === item.path && 
                    t.item.workspaceId === item.workspaceId
                );
            }
        }

        // 2. Fallback: If no item, or item yielded nothing, check Active Tab
        if (!previewTab) {
            const active = State.tabs.find(t => t.id === State.activeTabId);
            if (active) {
                if (active.isPreview || active.fileType === 'html-preview') {
                    previewTab = active;
                } else {
                    // Try to find a preview matching the active source file
                    previewTab = State.tabs.find(t => 
                        (t.isPreview || t.fileType === 'html-preview') && 
                        t.item.path === active.item.path && 
                        t.item.workspaceId === active.item.workspaceId
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        if (!previewTab) {
            console.warn("B\"H - DevTools Opener: No active or related preview vessel found.");
            import('../ui.js').then(m => m.UI.showToast("No Preview found for this file. Open Preview first.", "warning"));
            return;
        }

        console.log(`B\"H - DevTools: Creating inspection vessel for [${previewTab.item.name}]`);

        // Check if a devtools tab for this preview already exists
        const existingDevToolsTab = State.tabs.find(t => t.fileType === 'devtools' && t.devtoolsState?.previewTabId === previewTab.id);
        if (existingDevToolsTab) {
            Tabs.activate(existingDevToolsTab.id);
            return;
        }

        // B"H - Create a new, dedicated DevTools tab linked to the preview tab.
        const devToolsItem = {
            name: `DevTools: ${previewTab.item.name}`,
            type: 'devtools',
            kind: 'file', // Virtual file
            path: `devtools://${previewTab.item.path}`,
            previewTabId: previewTab.id // The sacred link
        };
        
        await Tabs.create(devToolsItem);
    }
};

/**
 * B"H - Initializes the static link between the system and the DevTools class.
 */
export function initializeDevToolsStatics() {
    import('./index.js').then(module => {
        if (module.DevTools) {
             module.DevTools.openForActivePreview = () => DevToolsOpener.open();
        }
    });
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file humanUI.js
 * @brief Dedicated UI controller for the Golem's Word, harnessing the 8 Gates of Speech.
 */

export class HumanUI {
    static attach(renderer, orator) {
        const uiArea = document.getElementById('custom-controls-area');
        if (!uiArea) return;
        uiArea.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous instances

        const container = document.createElement('div');
        container.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,204,0.2); padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);";
        
        const label = document.createElement('div');
        label.textContent = 'B"H - EIGHT GATES OF SPEECH';
        label.style.cssText = "color: #00ffcc; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 5px; text-align: center;";
        container.appendChild(label);

        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.style.cssText = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px;";
        
        const phonemes = orator.getGateLabels().map((label, i) => ({ id: i, label }));

        phonemes.forEach(p => {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.textContent = p.label;
            btn.dataset.gate = p.id;
            btn.style.cssText = "padding: 8px; font-size: 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #ccc; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.2s;";
            
            btn.onclick = () => {
                if (orator.isStreaming) return; 
                // B"H - Hold this sacred form indefinitely until commanded otherwise
                orator.setPhoneme(p.id, Infinity);
                this.updateActiveStyle(grid, btn);
            };

            grid.appendChild(btn);
        });

        const talkBtn = document.createElement('button');
        talkBtn.id = 'human-talk-toggle';
        talkBtn.textContent = '🗣️ DIVINE STREAM';
        talkBtn.style.cssText = "grid-column: span 2; padding: 12px; font-weight: bold; background: rgba(0,255,100,0.1); color: #00ffcc; border: 1px solid #00ffcc; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 4px; cursor: pointer;";
        
        talkBtn.onclick = () => {
            orator.isStreaming = !orator.isStreaming;
            talkBtn.textContent = orator.isStreaming ? '🛑 HALT STREAM' : '🗣️ DIVINE STREAM';
            talkBtn.style.color = orator.isStreaming ? '#ff55aa' : '#00ffcc';
            talkBtn.style.borderColor = orator.isStreaming ? '#ff55aa' : '#00ffcc';
            if (!orator.isStreaming) {
                // Return to peace and silence
                orator.setPhoneme(0, Infinity); 
                this.updateActiveStyle(grid, null);
            }
        };
        
        grid.appendChild(talkBtn);
        container.appendChild(grid);
        uiArea.appendChild(container);
    }

    static updateActiveStyle(grid, activeBtn) {
        grid.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
            if (b.id === 'human-talk-toggle') return;
            b.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
            b.style.color = '#ccc';
            b.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
        });
        if (activeBtn) {
            activeBtn.style.background = 'rgba(0,255,204,0.2)';
            activeBtn.style.color = '#00ffcc';
            activeBtn.style.borderColor = '#00ffcc';
        }
    }
}
```

## Directory: `js/git`

### File: `js/git/meta.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file meta.js
 * @brief Ascends the directory hierarchy to find repository markers.
 */

import { FileSystemProvider } from '../fs-provider.js';
import { State } from '../state.js';

export const GitMetaProvider = {
    _cache: new Map(),

    getPhysicalType(item) {
        const wsId = item.workspaceId || item.id;
        const ws = State.workspaces.find(w => w.id === wsId);
        return ws ? (ws.originalType || ws.type) : (item.originalType || item.type);
    },

    async getGitInfoForFolder(item) {
        if (!item || item.type === 'github') return item; 

        const physicalType = this.getPhysicalType(item);
        const wsId = item.workspaceId || item.id;
        let currentPath = item.path;

        // B"H - Tikkun: Check if the current item itself is the root
        // by looking for the presence of the .awtsmoos-repo folder directly
        if (item.kind === 'directory') {
            try {
                const listing = await FileSystemProvider.list(item);
                const entries = listing.entries || listing; // handle array or object
                const hasRepoMarker = entries.some(e => e.name === '.awtsmoos-repo');
                
                if (hasRepoMarker) {
                    const markerPath = `${item.path === '/' ? '' : item.path}/.awtsmoos-repo/ikar.js`;
                    const lookup = { path: markerPath, kind: 'file', workspaceId: wsId, type: physicalType };
                    try {
                        const raw = await FileSystemProvider.read(lookup);
                        const info = this._parseMarker(raw);
                        if (info && info.isClone) {
                            return { ...info, path: item.path, workspaceId: wsId };
                        }
                    } catch(readErr) { /* ignore read error */ }
                }
            } catch(listErr) { /* ignore list error */ }
        }

        // Standard Ascension Logic
        let limit = 25; 
        while (limit-- > 0) {
            const cacheKey = `${wsId}::${currentPath}`;
            if (this._cache.has(cacheKey)) return this._cache.get(cacheKey);

            try {
                const markerPath = `${currentPath === '/' ? '' : currentPath}/.awtsmoos-repo/ikar.js`;
                const lookup = { 
                    path: markerPath, 
                    kind: 'file', 
                    workspaceId: wsId, 
                    type: physicalType 
                };
                
                const raw = await FileSystemProvider.read(lookup);
                const info = this._parseMarker(raw);
                
                if (info && info.isClone) {
                    const res = { ...info, path: currentPath, workspaceId: wsId };
                    this._cache.set(cacheKey, res);
                    return res;
                }
            } catch(e) {
                // Ignore missing file errors as we traverse up
            }

            if (currentPath === '/' || currentPath === '') break;
            
            const lastSlash = currentPath.lastIndexOf('/');
            currentPath = (lastSlash <= 0) ? '/' : currentPath.substring(0, lastSlash);
        }
        return null;
    },

    _parseMarker(raw) {
        try {
            const text = (raw instanceof Blob) ? raw.text() : String(raw);
            const start = text.indexOf('{');
            const end = text.lastIndexOf('}') + 1;
            if (start === -1 || end === 0) return null;
            return JSON.parse(text.substring(start, end));
        } catch(e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
// FILE: js/terminal/shell.js

import { TerminalCommands } from './commands.js';
import { State } from '../state.js';

export class TerminalShell {
    constructor(tab, container) {
        this.tab = tab;
        this.container = container;
        this.state = tab.terminalState;
        
        // Ensure CWD is valid
        if (!this.state.cwd) {
            this.state.cwd = { kind: 'root', name: 'Workspaces', path: '/' };
        }
    }

    get cwd() { return this.state.cwd; }
    set cwd(val) { 
        this.state.cwd = val; 
        this.renderPrompt(); 
        
        // Update tab title to reflect location
        const name = val.kind === 'root' ? 'Terminal' : `Term: ${val.name}`;
        this.tab.item.name = name;
        this.tab.item.path = val.path;
    }

    init() {
        this.renderStructure();
        this.restoreOutput();
        this.renderPrompt();
        this.bindEvents();
        this.focus();
        
        if (this.state.output.length === 0) {
            this.print(`B"H\nSystem Terminal v1.0\nType 'help' for commands.`, "cmd-info");
        }
    }

    renderStructure() {
        this.container.innerHTML = `
            <div id="terminal-wrapper">
                <div class="terminal-output"></div>
                <div class="terminal-input-line">
                    <span class="terminal-directory"></span>
                    <input type="text" class="terminal-input" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off">
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        this.outputEl = this.container.querySelector('.terminal-output');
        this.inputEl = this.container.querySelector('.terminal-input');
        this.dirEl = this.container.querySelector('.terminal-directory');
    }

    restoreOutput() {
        this.state.output.forEach(line => {
            this.appendLine(line.text, line.className);
        });
    }

    renderPrompt() {
        // B"H - Prompt Styling Logic
        let promptText = "";
        
        if (this.cwd.kind === 'root') {
            promptText = "Workspaces > ";
        } else {
            const ws = State.workspaces.find(w => w.id === this.cwd.workspaceId);
            const wsName = ws ? ws.name : 'Unknown';
            // Normalize path to look nice (e.g., /folder/sub)
            let displayPath = this.cwd.path || '/';
            
            // Format: WorkspaceName path >
            promptText = `${wsName} ${displayPath} > `;
        }
        
        this.dirEl.textContent = promptText;
    }

    bindEvents() {
        this.container.addEventListener('click', () => this.inputEl.focus());
        
        this.inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', async (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                const cmd = this.inputEl.value.trim();
                this.inputEl.value = '';
                if (cmd) await this.execute(cmd);
                else this.printPromptLine("");
            }
        });
    }

    focus() {
        setTimeout(() => this.inputEl.focus(), 10);
    }

    printPromptLine(cmd) {
        // Use a distinct style for the prompt history
        const line = `<span class="terminal-prompt">${this.dirEl.textContent}</span> ${cmd}`;
        this.print(line, 'terminal-line-prompt');
    }

    print(text, className = '') {
        this.state.output.push({ text, className });
        this.appendLine(text, className);
    }
    
    appendLine(text, className) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = `terminal-line ${className}`;
        div.innerHTML = text; 
        this.outputEl.appendChild(div);
        this.outputEl.scrollTop = this.outputEl.scrollHeight;
    }

    clearScreen() {
        this.state.output = [];
        this.outputEl.innerHTML = '';
    }

    async execute(input) {
        this.printPromptLine(input);
        const args = input.split(' ');
        const cmd = args.shift();

        if (TerminalCommands[cmd]) {
            try {
                const result = await TerminalCommands[cmd](this, args);
                if (result !== null) this.print(result);
            } catch (e) {
                this.print(e.message, 'cmd-error');
            }
        } else {
            this.print(`Command not found: ${cmd}`, 'cmd-error');
        }
    }

    async resolveItem(path) {
        if (!path || path === '.') return this.cwd;
        
        // B"H - Root resolution logic
        if (this.cwd.kind === 'root') {
            // Can only cd into a workspace by name
            const ws = State.workspaces.find(w => w.name === path);
            if (ws) return { ...ws, path: '/', kind: 'directory', workspaceId: ws.id, type: ws.type };
            throw new Error(`Workspace '${path}' not found.`);
        }

        // Standard Workspace resolution
        // Handle Absolute Path (relative to workspace root)
        let finalPath = '';
        if (path.startsWith('/')) {
            finalPath = path;
        } else {
            // Join with current CWD
            const base = this.cwd.path === '/' ? '' : this.cwd.path;
            finalPath = `${base}/${path}`;
        }
        
        // Remove trailing slash if present (unless it is root)
        if (finalPath.length > 1 && finalPath.endsWith('/')) {
            finalPath = finalPath.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        return { 
            ...this.cwd, 
            path: finalPath, 
            name: finalPath.split('/').pop() || 'Root',
            kind: 'directory' 
        };
    }
}
```

### File: `js/terminal/commands.js`

```
// B"H
// FILE: js/terminal/commands.js

import { FileSystemProvider } from '../fs-provider.js';
import { State } from '../state.js';
import { Tabs } from '../tabs/index.js';

export const TerminalCommands = {
    async ls(shell, args) {
        const path = args[0] || '.';
        const targetItem = await shell.resolveItem(path);
        
        // B"H - Handle Root Level Listing (Workspaces)
        if (targetItem.kind === 'root') {
            const workspaces = State.workspaces;
            if (workspaces.length === 0) return "No workspaces found.";
            
            // Format workspaces as directories on new lines
            const rows = workspaces.map(ws => {
                return `<div class="ls-entry is-dir">${ws.name}/</div>`;
            });
            return rows.join('');
        }

        try {
            const result = await FileSystemProvider.list(targetItem);
            const entries = Array.isArray(result) ? result : (result.entries || []);
            
            if (entries.length === 0) {
                return ""; 
            }

            // B"H - Format items on new lines using divs
            const rows = entries.map(e => {
                const isDir = e.kind === 'directory';
                const suffix = isDir ? '/' : '';
                const cls = isDir ? 'is-dir' : 'is-file';
                return `<div class="ls-entry ${cls}">${e.name}${suffix}</div>`;
            });
            
            return rows.join('');
        } catch (e) {
            throw new Error(`ls: cannot access '${path}': ${e.message}`);
        }
    },

    async cd(shell, args) {
        const path = args[0];
        if (!path) return; 
        
        // B"H - Go to Root
        if (path === '/') {
             shell.cwd = { kind: 'root', name: 'Workspaces', path: '/' };
             return;
        }

        // Handle ..
        if (path === '..') {
            const current = shell.cwd.path;
            // If at workspace root, go to global root
            if (current === '/' || current === '') {
                shell.cwd = { kind: 'root', name: 'Workspaces', path: '/' };
                return;
            }
            // Go up one level
            const parentPath = current.substring(0, current.lastIndexOf('/')) || '/';
            // We need to preserve workspace ID
            shell.cwd = { ...shell.cwd, path: parentPath, name: parentPath.split('/').pop() || 'Root' };
            return;
        }

        const targetItem = await shell.resolveItem(path);
        
        // If targeting a workspace from root
        if (shell.cwd.kind === 'root' && targetItem.workspaceId) {
             shell.cwd = { ...targetItem, path: '/', kind: 'directory' };
             return;
        }

        // Verify existence for normal folders
        try {
            await FileSystemProvider.list(targetItem); 
            shell.cwd = targetItem;
        } catch(e) {
            throw new Error(`cd: ${path}: No such directory`);
        }
    },

    async pwd(shell) {
        if (shell.cwd.kind === 'root') return '/';
        const ws = State.workspaces.find(w => w.id === shell.cwd.workspaceId);
        const wsName = ws ? ws.name : 'Unknown';
        return `/${wsName}${shell.cwd.path}`;
    },

    async mkdir(shell, args) {
        if (shell.cwd.kind === 'root') throw new Error("mkdir: cannot create workspace from terminal yet.");
        if (!args[0]) throw new Error("mkdir: missing operand");
        const name = args[0];
        await FileSystemProvider.create(shell.cwd, name, 'directory');
        return '';
    },

    async touch(shell, args) {
        if (shell.cwd.kind === 'root') throw new Error("touch: cannot create file in root.");
        if (!args[0]) throw new Error("touch: missing operand");
        const name = args[0];
        await FileSystemProvider.create(shell.cwd, name, 'file');
        return '';
    },

    async rm(shell, args) {
        if (shell.cwd.kind === 'root') throw new Error("rm: cannot delete workspace from terminal.");
        if (!args[0]) throw new Error("rm: missing operand");
        const path = args[0];
        const item = await shell.resolveItem(path);
        await FileSystemProvider.delete(item);
        return '';
    },

    async cat(shell, args) {
        if (!args[0]) throw new Error("cat: missing operand");
        const path = args[0];
        const item = await shell.resolveItem(path);
        
        if (item.kind === 'directory' || item.kind === 'root') throw new Error(`cat: ${path}: Is a directory`);
        
        const content = await FileSystemProvider.read(item);
        if (content instanceof Blob) return await content.text();
        if (content && content.base64Content) return atob(content.base64Content);
        return String(content);
    },

    async open(shell, args) {
        if (!args[0]) throw new Error("open: missing operand");
        const path = args[0];
        const item = await shell.resolveItem(path);
        
        if (item.kind === 'directory') {
            import('../file-commander.js').then(m => m.FileCommander.open(item));
        } else {
            Tabs.create(item);
        }
        return `Opening ${item.name}...`;
    },

    clear(shell) {
        shell.clearScreen();
        return null; 
    },

    help() {
        return `B"H - Terminal Commands:
  ls [path]       List directory contents
  cd [path]       Change directory
  pwd             Print working directory
  mkdir [name]    Create directory
  touch [name]    Create empty file
  rm [path]       Remove file or directory
  cat [path]      Concatenate and print files
  open [path]     Open in Editor or Commander
  clear           Clear screen`;
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file idle.js
 * @brief Deep, hyper-realistic living idle state spanning 10 seconds.
 */
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file teethBuilder.js
 * @brief
 *   THE DENTAL THRONE — Two Rows, One Occlusion Plane
 *   ===================================================
 *   Both arches are constructed so their occlusal surfaces meet at local Y=0
 *   in arch-local space. The attachment offset then places the arch inside the
 *   mouth at the correct world position.
 *
 * @module teethBuilder
 */

// B"H - Precise offsets to nestle the teeth behind the CSG lips
export const TEETH_OFFSET_TOP    = [0, 0.05, -0.25];
export const TEETH_OFFSET_BOTTOM = [0, -0.05, -0.25];

export const ARCH = {
    WIDTH:       0.35,   // Narrowed to fit the precise cavity
    DEPTH:       0.2,    // Front-to-back depth
    CURVE:       3.0,    // Parabola steepness
    TOOTH_COUNT: 14,     // Tooth count
    TOOTH_W:     0.035,  // Tooth width (X)
    TOOTH_H:     0.08,   // Tooth height (Y)
    TOOTH_D:     0.03,   // Tooth depth (Z)
    GUM_RADIUS:  0.035,  // Gum tube radius
    GUM_SEGS:    8,      // Gum tube smoothness
    GUM_COLOR:   [0.85, 0.35, 0.40, 1.0], 
    TOOTH_COLOR: [0.98, 0.98, 0.96, 1.0]
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §1  ARCH CURVE HELPERS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _archZ(t) {
    const x = t * (ARCH.WIDTH / 2);
    return -(x * x) * ARCH.CURVE;
}

function _archAngle(t) {
    const x = t * (ARCH.WIDTH / 2);
    return Math.atan2(-2 * x * ARCH.CURVE, 1) * 0.45;
}

// §2  GUM TUBE BUILDER
```

### File: `tests/scenes/human/mouth/tongueBuilder.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file tongueBuilder.js
 * @brief
 *   THE TONGUE — The Primary Organ of Divine Articulation
 *   ======================================================
 *   Anchored to the 'jaw' bone via 'mouth_opening_center' so it descends
 *   naturally when the jaw opens, perfectly positioned behind the teeth.
 *
 * @module tongueBuilder
 */

export const TONGUE = {
    SCALE_X:  0.15,
    SCALE_Y:  0.06,
    SCALE_Z:  0.25,
    OFFSET_Y: -0.15, 
    OFFSET_Z: -0.35, // Pushed deeper into the CSG cavity to avoid clipping teeth
    COLOR:    [0.85, 0.35, 0.4, 1.0]
};

export function createTongue(id) {
    return {
        id,
        primitive: 'uvSphere',
        parameters: {
            radius:   1.0,
            rings:    10,
            segments: 16,
            smooth:   true
        },
        modifiers: [
            { type: 'scaleMesh',    scale: [TONGUE.SCALE_X, TONGUE.SCALE_Y, TONGUE.SCALE_Z] },
            { type: 'smoothNormals' }
        ],
        shaderVars: {
            uMaterialType: 'lambert',
            uBaseColor:    [TONGUE.COLOR[0], TONGUE.COLOR[1], TONGUE.COLOR[2]]
        },
        doubleSided: false,
        attachment: {
            bone:             'jaw',
            useExportedPoint: 'mouth_opening_center', // B"H - Perfect frontal origin
            offset:           [0, TONGUE.OFFSET_Y, TONGUE.OFFSET_Z]
        }
    };
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file humanSceneObjects.js
 * @chapter THE GATHERING OF FORMS
 * 
 * We place the house and the eyes directly into the path of the Golem
 * to ensure their presence is clear and undeniable.
 * 
 * THE HYMN OF THE COMPLETE SCENE:
 * The human alone is but a form in the void,
 * But placed in a world, its purpose is employed.
 * We sculpt the terrain, with mountains and plains,
 * Add the endless ocean, with its rhythmic strains.
 * The Golem stands ready, at the center of it all,
 * A testament to creation, responding to the call.
 * 
 * @module humanSceneObjects
 * @exports {Function} getHumanSceneObjects - Generates the complete human scene
 */

import { createRiggedHuman } from '../../core/components/human/index.js';
import { createMarchingCloudCluster } from '../clouds/marchingCloudGenerator.js';

/**
 * Generates all objects for the human test scene.
 * 
 * THE POEM OF THE SCENE ASSEMBLY:
 * First the terrain, sculpted with divine care,
 * Then the Golem, manifested with hair and stare.
 * The ocean stretches endless, a mirror of the sky,
 * And clouds float above, as the moments fly by.
 * Each object placed with purpose, in harmonious relation,
 * Creating a world, for the human's contemplation.
 * 
 * @function getHumanSceneObjects
 * @returns {Array<Object>} Array of scene objects ready for rendering
 * 
 * @example
 * const sceneObjects = getHumanSceneObjects();
 * // Returns terrain, human, ocean, and clouds for a complete environment
 */
export function getHumanSceneObjects() {
  // 1. Create the rigged human at the scene center
  const human = createRiggedHuman('golem_manifest');
  
  // 2. Create the sculpted terrain with physics collision
  const continent = {
    id: 'physics_terrain',
    primitive: 'plane',
    parameters: { size: 1.0, color: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0] },
    modifiers: [
      { type: 'scaleMesh', scale: [2200, 1, 2200] },
      { type: 'subdivide', levels: 6 },
      { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [0, 0, -250], radius: 200, amount: [0, 45, 0], falloff: 'dome', noise: 0.0 } },
      { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [500, 0, 150], radius: 180, amount: [0, 35, 0], falloff: 'smooth', noise: 0.0 } },
      { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [-450, 0, -100], radius: 150, amount: [0, 30, 0], falloff: 'sharp', noise: 0.0 } },
      { type: 'smoothNormals' }
    ],
    shaderVars: {
      uMaterialType: 'reflective',
      uTexture: 'dirt',
      uUseTriplanar: 1.0,
      uRoughness: 1.0,
      uMetallic: 0.0,
      uTextureScale: 150.0
    },
    simulation: { type: 'static_collider' },
    keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 15, 0] }]
  };
  
  // 3. Create the infinite ocean plane
  const ocean = {
    id: 'ocean_master',
    primitive: 'plane',
    parameters: { size: 10 },
    shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'ocean' },
    keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0] }]
  };
  
  // 4. Create majestic marching clouds
  const cloud = createMarchingCloudCluster('god_cloud_1', [35000, 15000, -40000], 85.0);
  
  // 5. Position the human on the terrain plateau
  human.keyframes = [{ time: 0, position: [0, 208, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }];
  
  return [
    continent,
    human,
    ocean,
    cloud
  ];
}
```

### File: `tests/scenes/human/humanGenerator.js`

```
// B"H
import { HUMAN_SKELETON_DATA } from './skeletonData.js';
import { HUMAN_MODIFIER_SEQUENCE } from './modifiers/index.js';
import { STANDARD_HUMAN_ANIMATIONS } from './animations/standardHumanAnimations.js';
import { manifestHeadAttachments } from './attachments/index.js';
import { generateProceduralGeometry } from '../../../core/geometry/geometryGenerator.js';
import { createDentalArch } from './mouth/teethBuilder.js';
import { createTongue } from './mouth/tongueBuilder.js';

export function createRiggedHuman(id, sceneTracksObj = {}) {
    
    const finalModifiers =[
        ...HUMAN_MODIFIER_SEQUENCE,
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_top', axis: 'y', direction: 1 } },
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_bottom', axis: 'y', direction: -1 } },
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_front', axis: 'z', direction: 1 } },
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_back', axis: 'z', direction: -1 } },
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_right', axis: 'x', direction: 1 } },
        { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'head_all', pointName: 'head_left', axis: 'x', direction: -1 } },
        
        // B"H - Exporting the exact centroid of the oral cavity regions
        { type: 'exportCentroid', params: { tag: 'mouth_ceiling', pointName: 'mouth_ceiling_center' } },
        { type: 'exportCentroid', params: { tag: 'mouth_floor', pointName: 'mouth_floor_center' } },
        { type: 'exportCentroid', params: { tag: 'mouth_inner', pointName: 'mouth_cavity_center' } }
        // lip_rim / mouth_opening_center is captured natively in MOUTH_CAVITY_MODS now.
    ];

    const probeObject = { id: `${id}_probe`, exportedPoints: {} };
    generateProceduralGeometry('cube', { size: 1.0 }, finalModifiers, probeObject);
    
    const pts = probeObject.exportedPoints;
    let headMetrics = { radius: 1.15, hairThickness: 0.25 }; 
    
    if (pts && pts.head_right && pts.head_left && pts.head_top) {
        headMetrics = {
            top: pts.head_top,
            front: pts.head_front,
            radius: (pts.head_right[0] - pts.head_left[0]) / 2.0,
            hairThickness: 0.25 
        };
    }
    
    if (pts && pts.mouth_opening_center) {
        console.log(`B"H - [${id}]: Mouth Opening Center manifested at [${pts.mouth_opening_center.map(v=>v.toFixed(2)).join(', ')}]`);
    } else {
        console.error(`B"H - [${id}]: FATAL ERROR! Mouth Opening Center not found! The vessel has no path for speech.`);
    }

    const attachments = manifestHeadAttachments(id, sceneTracksObj, headMetrics);

    // B"H - Manifesting the Internal Organs of Speech, now perfectly anchored inside the cavity!
    const upperTeeth = createDentalArch(`${id}_teeth_upper`, true);
    const lowerTeeth = createDentalArch(`${id}_teeth_lower`, false);
    const tongue = createTongue(`${id}_tongue`);

    attachments.push(upperTeeth, lowerTeeth, tongue);

    return {
        id,
        primitive: 'cube',
        parameters: { size: 1.0 },
        skeleton: HUMAN_SKELETON_DATA,
        modifiers: finalModifiers, 
        animations:[...STANDARD_HUMAN_ANIMATIONS],
        position: [0, 0, 0], 
        shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'lambert' },
        children: attachments
    };
}
```

### File: `tests/scenes/menorah/gavia.js`

```
// B"H
import { generateProceduralGeometry } from '../../../core/geometry/geometryGenerator.js';
import { CSG } from '../../../core/geometry/csg/index.js';
import { computeSmoothNormalsModifier } from '../../../core/geometry/modifiers/computeNormals.js';

/**
 * @file gavia.js
 * @brief This module contains the blueprint for the 'Gavia', the simple tapered cup
 *        of the Menorah, manifested through the sacred art of Constructive Solid Geometry.
 */

/**
 * B"H - Generates the complete scene object data for a Gavia (tapered cup).
 * @returns {object} A scene object definition.
 */
export function createGavia() {
    const thickness = 0.04; // Halved
    const goldMaterial = { uMaterialType: 'reflective', uBaseColor: [0.83, 0.68, 0.21], uMetallic: 1.0, uRoughness: 0.1 };
    
    const outerShellData = generateProceduralGeometry(
        'cylinder',
        { radiusTop: 0.5, radiusBottom: 0.3, height: 0.75, radialSegments: 24, smooth: true } // Halved/Adjusted
    );
    
    const innerCutterData = generateProceduralGeometry(
        'cylinder',
        { radiusTop: 0.5 - thickness, radiusBottom: 0.3 - thickness, height: 0.8, radialSegments: 24, smooth: true }, // Halved/Adjusted
        [ { type: 'translateMesh', translation: [0, thickness, 0] } ]
    );

    const outerCSG = CSG.fromMesh(outerShellData);
    const innerCSG = CSG.fromMesh(innerCutterData);
    let finalMesh = outerCSG.subtract(innerCSG).toMesh();
    
    finalMesh = computeSmoothNormalsModifier(finalMesh);
    
    const vertCount = finalMesh.positions.length / 3;
    finalMesh.colors = new Float32Array(vertCount * 4).fill(1.0);

    return {
        id: 'gavia_component',
        primitive: 'none',
        ...finalMesh,
        shaderVars: goldMaterial,
    };
}
```

```
export function createOilLamp() {
    const goldMaterial = { uMaterialType: 'reflective', uBaseColor: [0.83, 0.68, 0.21], uMetallic: 1.0, uRoughness: 0.1 };
    const thickness = 0.05;
    const radius = 0.5;

    // 1. A hollow sphere is our base
    const outerSphere = generateProceduralGeometry('icosphere', { radius: radius, subdivisions: 2, smooth: true });
    const innerSphere = generateProceduralGeometry('icosphere', { radius: radius - thickness, subdivisions: 2, smooth: true });
    
    const hollowSphereCSG = CSG.fromMesh(outerSphere).subtract(CSG.fromMesh(innerSphere));

    // 2. A large box to cut the top off
    const cutterBox = generateProceduralGeometry('cube', { size: 4.0 }, [
        { type: 'translateMesh', translation: [0, 1.8, 0] } // Positioned to cut above y=-0.2
    ]);
    const cutterCSG = CSG.fromMesh(cutterBox);
    
    // 3. Final CSG operation
    let finalMesh = hollowSphereCSG.subtract(cutterCSG).toMesh();

    finalMesh = computeSmoothNormalsModifier(finalMesh);

    const vertCount = finalMesh.positions.length / 3;
    finalMesh.colors = new Float32Array(vertCount * 4).fill(1.0);

    return {
        id: 'oil_lamp_component',
        primitive: 'none',
        ...finalMesh,
        shaderVars: goldMaterial,
    };
}
```

```
// B"H
import { generateProceduralGeometry } from '../../../core/geometry/geometryGenerator.js';
import { CSG } from '../../../core/geometry/csg/index.js';
import { computeSmoothNormalsModifier } from '../../../core/geometry/modifiers/computeNormals.js';

/**
 * @file kaftor.js
 * @brief This module contains the blueprint for the 'Kaftor', the sculpted flower-cup
 *        of the Menorah, manifested through the sacred art of Constructive Solid Geometry.
 */

/**
 * B"H - Generates the complete scene object data for a Kaftor (flower-cup).
 * @returns {object} A scene object definition.
 */
export function createKaftor() {
    const thickness = 0.04; // Halved
    const goldMaterial = { uMaterialType: 'reflective', uBaseColor: [0.83, 0.68, 0.21], uMetallic: 1.0, uRoughness: 0.1 };

    const sculptModifiers = [
        { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [0.55, 0.3, 0], radius: 0.45, amount: [0.15, -0.1, 0], falloff: 'smooth' } },
        { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [-0.55, 0.3, 0], radius: 0.45, amount: [-0.15, -0.1, 0], falloff: 'smooth' } },
        { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [0, 0.3, 0.55], radius: 0.45, amount: [0, -0.1, 0.15], falloff: 'smooth' } },
        { type: 'sculpt', params: { center: [0, 0.3, -0.55], radius: 0.45, amount: [0, -0.1, -0.15], falloff: 'smooth' } },
    ];
    
    const outerShellData = generateProceduralGeometry(
        'cylinder',
        { radiusTop: 0.5, radiusBottom: 0.3, height: 0.6, radialSegments: 24, smooth: true },
        [{ type: 'subdivide', levels: 1 }, ...sculptModifiers]
    );
    
    const innerCutterData = generateProceduralGeometry(
        'cylinder',
        { radiusTop: 0.5 - thickness, radiusBottom: 0.3 - thickness, height: 0.65, radialSegments: 24, smooth: true },
        [
            { type: 'translateMesh', translation: [0, thickness, 0] },
            { type: 'subdivide', levels: 1 },
            ...sculptModifiers
        ]
    );

    const outerCSG = CSG.fromMesh(outerShellData);
    const innerCSG = CSG.fromMesh(innerCutterData);
    let finalCupMesh = outerCSG.subtract(innerCSG).toMesh();
    
    finalCupMesh = computeSmoothNormalsModifier(finalCupMesh);
    
    const vertCount = finalCupMesh.positions.length / 3;
    finalCupMesh.colors = new Float32Array(vertCount * 4).fill(1.0);

    return {
        id: 'kaftor_component',
        primitive: 'none',
        ...finalCupMesh,
        shaderVars: goldMaterial,
    };
}
```
