```
// B"H
import { createSphere } from './sphere.js';
import { createKaftor } from './kaftor.js';
import { createGavia } from './gavia.js';
import { createOilLamp } from './oilLamp.js';
import { generateProceduralGeometry } from '../../../core/geometry/geometryGenerator.js';
import { mat4_core } from '../../../core/math/mat4/core.js';
import { mat4_transformations } from '../../../core/math/mat4/transformations.js';
import { computeSmoothNormalsModifier } from '../../../core/geometry/utils/index.js';

/**
 * @file menorahAssembly.js
 * @brief This holy scroll contains the divine instructions for manifesting the Menorah,
 *        not as a collection of parts, but as a single, unified vessel, its many
 *        forms merged into one geometric soul.
 */

/**
 * B"H - Traverses a scene graph hierarchy, calculating world matrices and collecting
 * all renderable geometry into a flat list for merging.
 * @param {object} object - The current scene object node.
 * @param {Array} parentMatrix - The world matrix of the parent object.
 * @param {Array} collection - The array to push results into.
 */
function flattenHierarchy(object, parentMatrix, collection) {
    let localMatrix = mat4_core.identity();
    if (object.keyframes && object.keyframes[0]) {
        const kf = object.keyframes[0];
        if(kf.position) mat4_transformations.translate(localMatrix, kf.position);
        if(kf.rotation) {
            mat4_transformations.rotateX(localMatrix, kf.rotation[0]);
            mat4_transformations.rotateY(localMatrix, kf.rotation[1]);
            mat4_transformations.rotateZ(localMatrix, kf.rotation[2]);
        }
        if(kf.scale) mat4_transformations.scale(localMatrix, kf.scale);
    }
    
    const worldMatrix = mat4_core.identity();
    mat4_core.multiply(worldMatrix, parentMatrix, localMatrix);

    let geometry = null;
    if (object.primitive && object.primitive !== 'none') {
        geometry = generateProceduralGeometry(object.primitive, object.parameters || {}, object.modifiers || []);
    } else if (object.positions) {
        geometry = {
            positions: object.positions, normals: object.normals, 
            indices: object.indices, colors: object.colors
        };
    }

    if (geometry) {
        collection.push({ geometry, matrix: worldMatrix, shaderVars: object.shaderVars });
    }

    if (object.children) {
        object.children.forEach(child => flattenHierarchy(child, worldMatrix, collection));
    }
}


/**
 * B"H - The sacred act of unification. Takes many geometries and merges them into one.
 * @param {Array} parts - An array of { geometry, matrix, shaderVars } objects.
 * @returns {object} A single, unified geometry object.
 */
function mergeGeometries(parts, finalMaterial) {
    const final = { positions: [], normals: [], colors: [], indices: [] };
    let vertexOffset = 0;

    for (const part of parts) {
        const { geometry, matrix } = part;
        if (!geometry || !geometry.positions || !geometry.indices) continue;

        const normalMatrix = mat4_core.identity();
        const invMat = mat4_core.inverse(mat4_core.identity(), matrix);
        if (invMat) mat4_core.transpose(normalMatrix, invMat);

        const pos = geometry.positions;
        const norm = geometry.normals;
        const col = geometry.colors || [];

        // Transform and add vertices
        for (let i = 0; i < pos.length; i += 3) {
            const pIn = [pos[i], pos[i+1], pos[i+2]];
            const pOut = mat4_core.transformPoint([], pIn, matrix);
            final.positions.push(...pOut);

            const nIn = [norm[i], norm[i+1], norm[i+2]];
            const nOut = mat4_core.transformPoint([], nIn, normalMatrix); // Normals transform w/ inv transpose
            final.normals.push(...nOut);

            final.colors.push(col[ (i/3)*4 ] || 1.0, col[ (i/3)*4 + 1] || 1.0, col[ (i/3)*4 + 2] || 1.0, col[ (i/3)*4 + 3] || 1.0);
        }

        // Add and offset indices
        for (let i = 0; i < geometry.indices.length; i++) {
            final.indices.push(geometry.indices[i] + vertexOffset);
        }
        
        vertexOffset += pos.length / 3;
    }

    // B"H - We do not smooth the final normals, to preserve the distinct forms of the components.
    // const mergedMesh = computeSmoothNormalsModifier(final);

    return {
        id: 'menorah_merged_assembly',
        primitive: 'none',
        ...final,
        shaderVars: finalMaterial
    };
}


/**
 * B"H - Assembles the complete Menorah, returning a single, unified mesh.
 * @returns {object} A scene object containing the merged Menorah geometry.
 */
export function createMenorahAssembly() {
    const goldMaterial = { uMaterialType: 'reflective', uBaseColor: [0.83, 0.68, 0.21], uMetallic: 1.0, uRoughness: 0.1 };
    const TEFACH = 1.0;
    
    const branchRadius = TEFACH / 4;
    const angle = Math.PI / 4;
    const cos45 = Math.cos(angle);

    const createBranchPair = (yPos, idPrefix) => {
        const verticalHeight = (18 * TEFACH) - yPos;
        const totalLength = verticalHeight / cos45;
        const cylinderHeight = totalLength;

        const branchCylinder = {
            primitive: 'cylinder',
            parameters: { radiusTop: branchRadius, radiusBottom: branchRadius, height: cylinderHeight, radialSegments: 16, smooth: true },
            shaderVars: goldMaterial,
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, cylinderHeight / 2, 0] }]
        };
        
        const cupYOffset = 0.15; // The divine elevation

        const kaftor = { ...createKaftor(), id: `${idPrefix}_kaftor`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, cylinderHeight - 0.3, 0] }] };
        const sphere = createSphere({ id: `${idPrefix}_sphere`, radius: TEFACH / 2, position: [0, cylinderHeight - 1.1, 0] });
        const gvia1 = { ...createGavia(), id: `${idPrefix}_gvia1`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, cylinderHeight - 1.975 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };
        const gvia2 = { ...createGavia(), id: `${idPrefix}_gvia2`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, cylinderHeight - 2.525 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };
        const gvia3 = { ...createGavia(), id: `${idPrefix}_gvia3`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, cylinderHeight - 3.075 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };

        const createGroup = (side, rotation) => ({
            id: `${idPrefix}_${side}_group`, primitive: 'none',
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, yPos, 0], rotation: [0, 0, rotation] }],
            children: [ branchCylinder, kaftor, sphere, gvia1, gvia2, gvia3 ]
        });
        return [ createGroup('left', angle), createGroup('right', -angle) ];
    };

    const cupYOffset = 0.15; // The divine elevation

    const base = { id: 'base', primitive: 'cube', shaderVars: goldMaterial, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 1 * TEFACH, 0], scale: [8 * TEFACH, 2 * TEFACH, 8 * TEFACH] }] };
    const flower3 = { ...createKaftor(), id: 'flower_3', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 2.3 * TEFACH, 0] }] };
    const cluster6 = {
        id: 'cluster_6', primitive: 'none', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 6 * TEFACH, 0] }],
        children: [
            { ...createGavia(), id: 'gavia_6', keyframes: [{ time: 0, rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI], position: [0.5, 0, 0] }] },
            createSphere({ id: 'sphere_6', radius: TEFACH / 2, position: [-0.25, 0, 0.433] }),
            { ...createKaftor(), id: 'kaftor_6', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-0.25, 0, -0.433] }] }
        ]
    };
    const centralBranch = {
        id: 'central_branch', primitive: 'cylinder',
        parameters: { radiusTop: branchRadius, radiusBottom: branchRadius, height: 18 * TEFACH, radialSegments: 24, smooth: true },
        shaderVars: goldMaterial, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, (18 * TEFACH) / 2, 0] }]
    };
    const centralKaftor = { ...createKaftor(), id: `central_kaftor`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 17.7, 0] }] };
    const centralSphere = createSphere({ id: `central_sphere`, radius: TEFACH / 2, position: [0, 16.9, 0] });
    const centralGvia1 = { ...createGavia(), id: `central_gvia1`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 16.025 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };
    const centralGvia2 = { ...createGavia(), id: `central_gvia2`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 15.475 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };
    const centralGvia3 = { ...createGavia(), id: `central_gvia3`, keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 14.925 + cupYOffset, 0], rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI] }] };

    const [branch_9_left, branch_9_right] = createBranchPair(9 * TEFACH, 'branch_9');
    const [branch_11_left, branch_11_right] = createBranchPair(11 * TEFACH, 'branch_11');
    const [branch_13_left, branch_13_right] = createBranchPair(13 * TEFACH, 'branch_13');

    const lampY = 18.5; // B"H - Elevated to perfection.

        { ...createOilLamp(), id: 'lamp_center', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, lampY, 0] }] },

        { ...createOilLamp(), id: 'lamp_right_2', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [7, lampY, 0] }] },

        { ...createOilLamp(), id: 'lamp_left_2', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-7, lampY, 0] }] },
        { ...createOilLamp(), id: 'lamp_left_3', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-9, lampY, 0] }] },
    ];

    const rootHierarchy = {
        id: 'menorah_hierarchy_root', primitive: 'none', keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0] }],
        children: [ base, flower3, cluster6, centralBranch, sphere9, sphere11, sphere13,

                    centralKaftor, centralSphere, centralGvia1, centralGvia2, centralGvia3, ...lamps ]
    };

    const partsToMerge = [];
    flattenHierarchy(rootHierarchy, mat4_core.identity(), partsToMerge);
    return mergeGeometries(partsToMerge, goldMaterial);
}
```

```
// B"H
import { TreeGenerator } from '../../../core/geometry/generators/tree/treeGenerator.js';
import { TREE_PRESETS } from '../../../core/geometry/generators/tree/presets/index.js';

/**
 * Creates a grass field definition.
 */
function createGrass(id, count, width, colorBottom, colorTop) {
    return {
        id: id,
        primitive: 'grass',
        parameters: { 
            count: count || 10000, 
            width: width || 50, 
            bladeWidth: 0.12,
            bladeHeight: 1.2,
            colorBottom: colorBottom || [0.1, 0.3, 0.1],
            colorTop: colorTop || [0.4, 0.8, 0.2]
        },
        keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }]
    };
}

/**
 * Generates the arboretum objects.
 */
export function generateArboretumObjects() {
    console.log("B\"H - Arboretum Generator: Pre-generating objects...");
    
    const objects = [];
    const presetKeys = Object.keys(TREE_PRESETS);
    const gridWidth = 5;
    const spacingX = 25;
    const spacingZ = 25;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const presetName = presetKeys[i % presetKeys.length];
        const basePreset = TREE_PRESETS[presetName];
        
        const config = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(basePreset));
        if (i >= 5) {
            config.seed += (i * 937); 
            config.name = `${config.name} (Variant)`;
        }

        const generator = new TreeGenerator(config);
        const data = generator.generate();
        
        const row = Math.floor(i / gridWidth);
        const col = i % gridWidth;
        const x = (col - (gridWidth - 1) / 2) * spacingX;
        const z = (row - 0.5) * spacingZ;

        // B"H - Sanitizing ID without regex
        const idBase = presetName.split(' ').join('');

        // Bark Mesh
        const barkMesh = {
            id: `tree_${i}_${idBase}_bark`,
            primitive: 'none', 
            positions: new Float32Array(data.branches.verts),
            normals: new Float32Array(data.branches.normals),
            indices: new Uint16Array(data.branches.indices),
            colors: new Float32Array((data.branches.verts.length / 3) * 4),
            shaderVars: { uTexture: config.bark.type, uTextureScale: 1.0, uUseTriplanar: 1.0, uAmbientLightColor: [0.6, 0.6, 0.6] },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [x, 0, z] }]
        };
        for(let k=0; k<data.branches.uvs.length; k+=2) {
            barkMesh.colors[k*2] = data.branches.uvs[k]; barkMesh.colors[k*2+1] = data.branches.uvs[k+1];
            barkMesh.colors[k*2+2] = 0.0; barkMesh.colors[k*2+3] = 1.0;
        }
        objects.push(barkMesh);
        
        // Leaf Mesh
        if (data.leaves.verts.length > 0) {
            const leafMesh = {
                id: `tree_${i}_${idBase}_leaves`,
                primitive: 'none',
                positions: new Float32Array(data.leaves.verts),
                normals: new Float32Array(data.leaves.normals),
                indices: new Uint16Array(data.leaves.indices),
                colors: new Float32Array(data.leaves.colors), 
                shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'leaf', uTexture: config.leaves.type, uTextureScale: 1.0, uAlphaTest: 0.35, uDoubleSided: 1.0, uWindEnabled: 1.0 },
                doubleSided: true,
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [x, 0, z] }]
            };
            const leafCount = data.leaves.verts.length / 3;
            for(let k=0; k<leafCount; k++) {
                leafMesh.colors[k*4] = data.leaves.uvs[k*2]; leafMesh.colors[k*4+1] = data.leaves.uvs[k*2+1];
                leafMesh.colors[k*4+2] = 1.0; leafMesh.colors[k*4+3] = 1.0;
            }
            objects.push(leafMesh);
        }
    }
    
    objects.push(createGrass('lush_meadow', 250000, 200, [0.1, 0.25, 0.05], [0.4, 0.8, 0.2]));
    objects.push({
        id: 'ground', primitive: 'plane', parameters: { size: 300, color: [0.55, 0.48, 0.42, 1.0] },
        shaderVars: { uTexture: 'dirt', uTextureScale: 40.0, uUseTriplanar: 1.0 }, 
        keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -0.05, 0] }]
    });

    return objects;
}
```

### File: `tests/scenes/utils/headGen.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file headGen.js
 * @brief Stable procedural humanoid geometry.
 *        The nose is now an autonomous entity, preserving the peace of the CSG engine.
 */
import { CSG } from '../../../core/geometry/csg/index.js';
import { createIcosphereMesh } from '../../../core/geometry/primitives/icosphere.js';
import { createCubeMesh } from '../../../core/geometry/primitives/cube.js';
import { createCylinderMesh } from '../../../core/geometry/primitives/cylinder.js';
import { meshToRenderData } from '../../../core/geometry/utils/meshData.js';
import { computeSmoothNormalsModifier } from '../../../core/geometry/modifiers/computeNormals.js';

const SUBDIVISIONS = 0; 
export const CUT_LEVEL_Y = -0.7; 
export const HINGE_Z = -1.2;      
export const EYE_X = 1.1;

function translateFlatMesh(mesh, x, y, z) {
    const p = mesh.positions;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) {
        p[i] += x; p[i + 1] += y; p[i + 2] += z;
    }
}

function applyGlobalHeadShape(mesh) {
    const p = mesh.positions;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) {
        let x = p[i], y = p[i+1], z = p[i+2];
        y *= 1.35; z *= 1.1; x *= 0.92;
        p[i] = x; p[i+1] = y; p[i+2] = z;
    }
}

export function createSplitHeadGeometry() {
    // 1. The Cranium Source
    const headRaw = meshToRenderData(createIcosphereMesh({ radius: 4.0, subdivisions: SUBDIVISIONS, smooth: true }));
    applyGlobalHeadShape(headRaw);

    // 2. The Isolated Nose (Standalone)
    // No union modifiers - pure primitive displacement
    const noseRaw = meshToRenderData(createCylinderMesh({ 
        radiusTop: 0.1, radiusBottom: 0.8, height: 1.8, radialSegments: 4 
    }));
    for(let i=0; i<noseRaw.positions.length; i+=3) {
        let x = noseRaw.positions[i], y = noseRaw.positions[i+1], z = noseRaw.positions[i+2];
        // Rotate and position for a noble profile
        noseRaw.positions[i] = x; 
        noseRaw.positions[i+1] = -z + 0.5; 
        noseRaw.positions[i+2] = y + 3.8;
    }

    // 3. The Skull/Jaw Split
    const headCSG = CSG.fromMesh(headRaw);
    const cutterRaw = meshToRenderData(createCubeMesh({ size: 1.0 })); 
    for(let i=0; i<cutterRaw.positions.length; i+=3) {
        cutterRaw.positions[i]*=12; cutterRaw.positions[i+1]*=12; cutterRaw.positions[i+2]*=15;
        cutterRaw.positions[i+1]+=CUT_LEVEL_Y-6; cutterRaw.positions[i+2]+=HINGE_Z+7.5;
    }
    const splitterCSG = CSG.fromMesh(cutterRaw);

    let skullMesh = headCSG.subtract(splitterCSG).toMesh();
    let jawMesh = headCSG.intersect(splitterCSG).toMesh();

    translateFlatMesh(jawMesh, 0, -CUT_LEVEL_Y, -HINGE_Z);

    const colorize = (m, c) => {
        const count = m.positions.length/3; m.colors = new Float32Array(count*4);
        for(let i=0; i<count*4; i+=4) { m.colors[i]=c[0]; m.colors[i+1]=c[1]; m.colors[i+2]=c[2]; m.colors[i+3]=c[3]; }
    };
    
    const skinTone = [0.94, 0.76, 0.64, 1.0];
    colorize(skullMesh, skinTone); 
    colorize(jawMesh, skinTone); 
    colorize(noseRaw, [0.9, 0.72, 0.6, 1.0]);

    return { 
        skullMesh: computeSmoothNormalsModifier(skullMesh), 
        jawMesh: computeSmoothNormalsModifier(jawMesh),
        noseMesh: computeSmoothNormalsModifier(noseRaw)
    };
}
```

```
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';

export const SCENE_DATA = {

            modifiers: [
```

```
                // 1. Extrude TOP face UP, then SCALE IT UP (Expansion)
                // Face 34 is roughly central top
                { type: 'extrude', face: 34, amount: 1.0 },
                { type: 'scaleFace', face: 34, amount: 1.8 }, // Scale > 1 expands the face
                { type: 'setFaceColor', face: 34, color: [1.0, 0.8, 0.2, 1.0] }, // Gold top

                // 2. Extrude FRONT face INWARDS (Hole)
                // Face 6 is roughly central front
                { type: 'extrude', face: 6, amount: -0.8 }, // Negative amount goes IN
                { type: 'setFaceColor', face: 6, color: [0.1, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0] }, // Dark inside

                // 3. B"H - Extrude RIGHT face OUT, Scale DOWN, and ROTATE (Twisted Spike)
                { type: 'extrude', face: 70, amount: 1.5 }, // Extrude Out
                { type: 'scaleFace', face: 70, amount: 0.4 }, // Taper to a point
                { type: 'rotateFace', face: 70, axis: 'x', angle: Math.PI / 4 }, // Twist 45 degrees
                { type: 'setFaceColor', face: 70, color: [0.6, 0.2, 0.8, 1.0] }, // Purple

                // 4. B"H - Extrude LEFT face IN, Scale UP (Widened Cave)
                { type: 'extrude', face: 85, amount: -0.5 }, // Extrude In
                { type: 'scaleFace', face: 85, amount: 1.4 }, // Scale Up (expands inside)
                { type: 'setFaceColor', face: 85, color: [0.0, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0] } // Cyan
            ],
            keyframes: [
                { time: 0, position: [2, 0, 0], rotation: [0, -Math.PI/4, 0], scale: [1,1,1] },
                { time: 10, position: [2, 0, 0], rotation: [0, Math.PI * 1.75, 0], scale: [1,1,1] }
            ]
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testBendScene.js
 * @brief This scene manifests a tall pillar that bends gracefully, a divine expression
 *        of structure yielding to flow, made possible by vertex shader deformation.
 */
export const SCENE_DATA = {
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 8, 15],
        target: [0, 1, 0], // B"H - Lowered to focus on the new, shorter pole's center.
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.3, 0.3, 0.4],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.0, 1.0, 0.9],
        uLightDirection: [0.8, 1.0, 0.5],
    },
    objects: [
        {
            id: 'bendingPole',
            primitive: 'cube',
            parameters: { 
                size: 1.0,
                color: [0.8, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0]
            },
            modifiers: [
                // B"H - A grounded and harmonious form.
                { type: 'scaleMesh', scale: [1.5, 2, 1.5] },
                
                // B"H - Increased subdivisions for a perfectly smooth 90-degree bend.
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 5 }
            ],
            shaderVars: {
                // B"H - This new shader variable enables the bending animation in the vertex shader.
                bendAnimation: {
                    speed: 0.7,
                    // B"H - Amplitude increased for a full 90-degree bend.
                    amplitude: 5.0,
                    direction: [1, 0], // Bend along the X axis only
                    // B"H - The base of the form is now at -1.0 before translation.
                    baseHeight: -1.0
```

```
/**
```

```
 *        The cloth falls under gravity and drapes over the cube, which is treated as a
 *        static collider with an octree for efficient collision detection.
 */
export const SCENE_DATA = {
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 8, 20],
        target: [0, 2, 0],
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {

        {
            id: 'falling_cloth',

                { type: 'translateMesh', translation: [0, 6, 0] },
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 5 } // 32x32 grid for smooth deformation
            ],
            simulation: {
                type: 'cloth',
                config: {
                    stiffness: 0.9,
                    mass: 0.1, // Light cloth
                    drag: 0.02,
                    pinFunction: null // Let it fall freely
                }
            },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }]
        },
        {
            id: 'collider_cube',
            primitive: 'cube',
            parameters: { size: 4.0, color: [0.6, 0.6, 0.7, 1.0] },
            simulation: {
                type: 'static_collider' // This tells the physics engine to build an octree
            },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 2, 0], rotation: [0, 0.2, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }]
        },
        {
            id: 'ground_plane',
            primitive: 'plane',
            parameters: { size: 40, color: [0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0]},
            simulation: { 
                type: 'static_collider' // The ground is also a static collider
            },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -0.1, 0] }]
        }
    ],
    // B"H - Post-load hook to manifest interactive controls.
    postLoadCallback: function(renderer) {
        const ui = renderer.uiManager;
        const clothSystem = renderer.clothSystem;
        if (!ui || !clothSystem) return;

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = '🌬️ Blow Wind';
        btn.style.cssText = `
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00c6ff, #0072ff);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: transform 0.1s ease;
        `;
        btn.onmousedown = () => btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
        btn.onmouseup = () => btn.style.transform = 'scale(1.0)';
        
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // A strong gust from the side and slightly upwards
            const gustVector = [8000, 2000, 4000]; 
            const duration = 0.5; // seconds
            clothSystem.applyGust(gustVector, duration);
        });

        ui.addCustomControl(btn);
    }
};
```

### File: `tests/scenes/testCSGScene.js`

```
// B"H
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';
import { createCubeMesh } from '../../core/geometry/primitives/cube.js';
import { createIcosphereMesh } from '../../core/geometry/primitives/icosphere.js';
import { createCylinderMesh } from '../../core/geometry/primitives/cylinder.js';
import { CSG } from '../../core/geometry/csg/index.js';
import { meshToRenderData } from '../../core/geometry/utils/meshData.js';

/**
 * @file testCSGScene.js
 * @brief Demonstrates efficient mesh duplication and stable CSG logic.
 *        Includes a corner-cut cube (Subtract), half-spheres (Subtract), 
 *        and welded pipes (Union).
 */

/**
 * B"H - Applies a solid color to a render-ready mesh data object.
 * Returns a new object to ensure data isolation.
 */
function colorize(meshData, color) {
    const vertCount = meshData.positions.length / 3;
    const colors = new Float32Array(vertCount * 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < vertCount; i++) {
        colors[i * 4] = color[0];
        colors[i * 4 + 1] = color[1];
        colors[i * 4 + 2] = color[2];
        colors[i * 4 + 3] = color[3];
    }
    return { ...meshData, colors };
}

/**
 * B"H - Generates the geometric soul of the corner-cut cube.
 */
function getBoxCutCubeMesh() {
    const boxA = meshToRenderData(createCubeMesh({ size: 4.0 }));
    const boxB = meshToRenderData(createCubeMesh({ size: 2.5 }));
    // Offset the carving cube manually
    for (let i = 0; i < boxB.positions.length; i += 3) {
        boxB.positions[i] += 1.8;
        boxB.positions[i + 1] += 1.8;
        boxB.positions[i + 2] += 1.8;
    }
    const csgA = CSG.fromMesh(boxA);
    const csgB = CSG.fromMesh(boxB);
    return csgA.subtract(csgB).toMesh();
}

/**
 * B"H - Generates the geometric soul of the half-icosphere.
 */
function getHalfSphereMesh() {
    const sphereA = meshToRenderData(createIcosphereMesh({ radius: 2.5, subdivisions: 2, smooth: true }));
    const boxB = meshToRenderData(createCubeMesh({ size: 6.0 }));
    // Move cube to bisect sphere along X
    for (let i = 0; i < boxB.positions.length; i += 3) {
        boxB.positions[i] += 3.0; 
    }
    const csgA = CSG.fromMesh(sphereA);
    const csgB = CSG.fromMesh(boxB);
    return csgA.subtract(csgB).toMesh();
}

/**
 * B"H - Generates a unified structure from two intersecting cylinders.
 *        Demonstrates internal geometry cleanup via Union.
 */
function getWeldedPipesMesh() {
    // 1. Vertical Pipe
    const pipeVertical = meshToRenderData(createCylinderMesh({ 
        radiusTop: 1.2, radiusBottom: 1.2, height: 6.0, radialSegments: 16, smooth: true 
    }));
    
    // 2. Horizontal Pipe (Base mesh, then rotated)
    const pipeHorizontal = meshToRenderData(createCylinderMesh({ 
        radiusTop: 1.0, radiusBottom: 1.0, height: 6.0, radialSegments: 16, smooth: true
    }));
    
    // Rotate horizontal pipe 90 deg on Z to align with X axis
    // Transformation: x' = -y, y' = x
    for(let i=0; i<pipeHorizontal.positions.length; i+=3) {
        const x = pipeHorizontal.positions[i];
        const y = pipeHorizontal.positions[i+1];
        pipeHorizontal.positions[i] = -y;
        pipeHorizontal.positions[i+1] = x;
        
        const nx = pipeHorizontal.normals[i];
        const ny = pipeHorizontal.normals[i+1];
        pipeHorizontal.normals[i] = -ny;
        pipeHorizontal.normals[i+1] = nx;
    }

    const csgA = CSG.fromMesh(pipeVertical);
    const csgB = CSG.fromMesh(pipeHorizontal);
    
    // The Union: A + B (removing inside parts)
    return csgA.union(csgB).toMesh();
}

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: { 
        "slowSpin": generateSpinTrack(15, 'y'),
        "reverseSpin": generateSpinTrack(12, 'y'),
        "tumble": {
            keyframes: [
                { time: 0, rotation: [0, 0, 0] },
                { time: 5, rotation: [Math.PI, Math.PI, 0] },
                { time: 10, rotation: [Math.PI*2, Math.PI*2, 0] }
            ]
        }
    },
    camera: { initialPosition: [0, 20, 45], target: [0, 0, 0] },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.3, 0.3, 0.35],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.0, 1.0, 0.9],
        uLightDirection: [0.5, 1.0, 0.5]
    },
    objects: function() {
        // 1. Calculate base meshes once for efficiency
        const boxCutMesh = getBoxCutCubeMesh();
        const halfSphereMesh = getHalfSphereMesh();
        const weldedPipesMesh = getWeldedPipesMesh();

        return [
            // A. The original corner-cut cube (Far Left)
            {
                id: 'corner_cut_cube',
                ...colorize(boxCutMesh, [1.0, 0.6, 0.0, 1.0]), // Gold
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-12, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }],
                animations: [{ track: "slowSpin", speed: 1.0 }]
            },
            
            // B. The first half-icosphere (Mid Left)
            {
                id: 'half_sphere_alpha',
                ...colorize(halfSphereMesh, [0.0, 0.8, 0.5, 1.0]), // Emerald
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-4, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }],
                animations: [{ track: "reverseSpin", speed: 1.0 }]
            },

            // C. The second half-icosphere (Mid Right - Duplicated)
            {
                id: 'half_sphere_beta',
                ...colorize(halfSphereMesh, [0.6, 0.3, 1.0, 1.0]), // Amethyst
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [4, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }],
                animations: [{ track: "slowSpin", speed: 1.2 }] 
            },

            // D. The Welded Pipes (Far Right - Union)
            {
                id: 'welded_pipes',
                ...colorize(weldedPipesMesh, [0.2, 0.6, 1.0, 1.0]), // Industrial Blue
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [12, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }],
                animations: [{ track: "tumble", speed: 0.8 }] 
            },

            // E. The grounding foundation
            {
                id: 'csg_ground', 
                primitive: 'grid', 
                parameters: { size: 80, divisions: 40, color: [0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1.0] },
                keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -3.0, 0], rotation: [0,0,0], scale: [1,1,1] }]
            }
        ];
    }
};
```

```
/**

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    camera: {

    },
```

```
            modifiers: [
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 2 }, // 4x4 grid per face
```

### File: `tests/scenes/testHairScene.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testHairScene.js
 * @brief Manifests a fully groomed head with natural randomness and organic distribution.
 */
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';
import { Vec3 } from '../../core/math/vec3.js';
import { generatePrismStrand } from '../../core/geometry/generators/hairGeometry.js';
import { getFibonacciSpherePoints } from '../../core/math/sampling/fibonacci.js';

function createHairPatch(id, config) {
    const { 
        count, 
        sphereRadius, 
        direction, 
        angleLimit, 
        length, 
        width,
        combStrength,
        combDir,
        colorBase,
        colorTip
    } = config;

    // 1. Generate reusable strand geometry
    const { positions, indices } = generatePrismStrand(8, 0.5);

    // 2. Calculate distribution
    // Safety clamp to avoid Infinity
    const limit = Math.max(-0.99, Math.min(0.99, angleLimit));
    const ratio = (1.0 - limit) / 2.0;
    const totalPointsNeeded = Math.ceil(count / ratio);
    
    // Generate deterministic even points
    const spherePoints = getFibonacciSpherePoints(totalPointsNeeded);
    
    const iOffsets = [];
    const iNormals = [];
    const iRandoms = [];

    const dirNorm = Vec3.normalize(direction);
    let validCount = 0;
    
    // B"H - Jitter Factor: Displaces roots from the perfect grid
    const JITTER = 0.08; 

    // 3. Filter points
    for(let i=0; i<spherePoints.length; i++) {
        if (validCount >= count) break;
        
        // Start with even point
        let p = [...spherePoints[i]];
        
        // B"H - Apply Random Jitter to break uniformity
        p[0] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * JITTER;
        p[1] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * JITTER;
        p[2] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * JITTER;
        
        // Re-normalize to stick to surface
        const len = Math.sqrt(p[0]*p[0] + p[1]*p[1] + p[2]*p[2]);
        p[0] /= len; p[1] /= len; p[2] /= len;
        
        // Check alignment with patch direction
        const dot = p[0]*dirNorm[0] + p[1]*dirNorm[1] + p[2]*dirNorm[2];
        
        if (dot > limit) {
            // Position on sphere surface
            iOffsets.push(p[0] * sphereRadius, p[1] * sphereRadius, p[2] * sphereRadius);
            
            // Normal is just the direction from center (p)
            iNormals.push(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
            
            // Random for variety (Used for length and width modulation)
            iRandoms.push(Math.random());
            
            validCount++;
        }
    }

    return {
        id: id, 
        primitive: 'none', 
        positions: positions, 
        indices: indices,
        instanceCount: validCount, 
        instanceOffsets: new Float32Array(iOffsets), 
        instanceNormals: new Float32Array(iNormals), 
        instanceRandoms: new Float32Array(iRandoms),
        hairParams: {
            colorBase: colorBase, 
            colorTip: colorTip, 
            length: length, 
            width: width,
            combStrength: combStrength,
            combDir: combDir
        },
        shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'hair' },
        keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0] }],
        animations: [{ track: 'spin', speed: 0.003 }] 
    };
}

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: { "spin": generateSpinTrack(600, 'y') },
    camera: { initialPosition: [0, 2, 10], target: [0, 0, 0] },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: { 
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.55, 0.55, 0.6], 
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.3, 1.3, 1.25], 
        uLightDirection: [0.6, 1.0, 0.8] 
    },
    objects: function() {
        const radius = 3.0;
        const colorBase = [0.35, 0.25, 0.18];
        const colorTip = [0.65, 0.55, 0.35];

        // 1. Scalp (Reduced Density, Natural Look)
        const scalp = createHairPatch('hair_scalp', {
            count: 5500, // Reduced from 8000
            sphereRadius: radius,
            direction: [0, 1, 0], // UP
            angleLimit: 0.3, 
            length: 0.85,
            width: 0.12,
            combStrength: 0.6,
            combDir: [0, -1, 0], 
            colorBase, colorTip
        });

        // 2. Sideburns (Connecting strips)
        const sideL = createHairPatch('hair_side_l', {
            count: 700, // Reduced from 1200
            sphereRadius: radius,
            direction: [-0.9, 0.1, 0.3], 
            angleLimit: 0.85, 
            length: 1.2,
            width: 0.12,
            combStrength: 0.8,
            combDir: [0, -1, 0],
            colorBase, colorTip
        });

        const sideR = createHairPatch('hair_side_r', {
            count: 700, // Reduced from 1200
            sphereRadius: radius,
            direction: [0.9, 0.1, 0.3], 
            angleLimit: 0.85, 
            length: 1.2,
            width: 0.12,
            combStrength: 0.8,
            combDir: [0, -1, 0],
            colorBase, colorTip
        });

        // 3. Beard
        const beard = createHairPatch('hair_beard', {
            count: 1600, // Reduced from 2500
            sphereRadius: radius,
            direction: [0, -0.6, 0.8], 
            angleLimit: 0.7, 
            length: 1.8,
            width: 0.13,
            combStrength: 0.95, 
            combDir: [0, -1, 0],

        });

        return [
```

### File: `tests/scenes/testHierarchyBendScene.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testHierarchyBendScene.js
 * @brief This scene manifests an articulated pole, a chain of hierarchical objects
 *        simulating a bone system. Each "bone" rotates with a phase-shifted animation,
 *        creating a complex, organic, and controlled bending motion that reveals the
 *        divine order of interconnected causality.
 */

/**
 * B"H - This function programmatically constructs the chain of "bone" segments.
 * It creates a parent-child hierarchy, where each segment is positioned relative
 * to the one before it, forming a continuous, articulated pole.
 * @returns {object} The root object of the articulated pole hierarchy.
 */
function createArticulatedPole() {
    const segmentCount = 8;
    const segmentHeight = 1.0;
    const segmentWidth = 0.8;
    const baseHeight = 0.5;
    const baseWidth = 1.2;

    // The root of our hierarchy, the stable foundation.
    let rootParent = {
        id: 'bone_base',
        primitive: 'cube',
        parameters: { size: 1.0, color: [0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 1.0] },
        modifiers: [ { type: 'scaleMesh', scale: [baseWidth, baseHeight, baseWidth] } ],
        // Positioned so its bottom rests exactly at y=0.
        keyframes: [ { time: 0, position: [0, baseHeight / 2, 0], rotation: [0,0,0], scale: [1,1,1] } ],
        children: []
    };
    
    let currentParent = rootParent;

    for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
        const parentHeightForCalc = (i === 0) ? baseHeight : segmentHeight;

        const newSegment = {
            id: `bone_segment_${i}`,
            primitive: 'cube',
            parameters: { size: 1.0, color: [0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 1.0] },
            modifiers: [ { type: 'scaleMesh', scale: [segmentWidth, segmentHeight, segmentWidth] } ],
            // Position this segment's center relative to its parent's center,
            // such that its bottom rests on the parent's top.
            keyframes: [ { time: 0, position: [0, (parentHeightForCalc / 2) + (segmentHeight / 2), 0], rotation: [0,0,0], scale: [1,1,1] } ],
            // Apply the waving animation with a phase offset for each segment.
            animations: [ { track: 'waving', speed: 1.0, offset: i * 2.5 } ],
            children: []
        };
        currentParent.children.push(newSegment);
        currentParent = newSegment; // The new segment becomes the parent for the next iteration.
    }

    return rootParent;
}

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: {
        // A single track defining a complex, multi-axis wave.
        // This is applied to each joint with an offset, creating the flowing motion.
        "waving": {
             keyframes: [
                 { time: 0, rotation: [0, 0, 0] },
                 { time: 5, rotation: [0, 0, 0.6] }, // Bend on Z axis
                 { time: 10, rotation: [0, 0, 0] },
                 { time: 15, rotation: [0.6, 0, 0] }, // Bend on X axis
                 { time: 20, rotation: [0, 0, 0] }
             ]
        }
    },
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 8, 15],
        target: [0, 4, 0],
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.3, 0.3, 0.4],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.0, 1.0, 0.9],
        uLightDirection: [0.8, 1.0, 0.5],
    },
    objects: [
        // Generate and add the articulated pole to the scene.
        createArticulatedPole(),
        // A solid ground plane, placed just below y=0 to prevent z-fighting.
        {
            id: 'ground',
            primitive: 'plane',
            parameters: { size: 40, color: [0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0] },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -0.01, 0], rotation: [0,0,0], scale: [1,1,1] }]
        }
    ]
};
```

```
/**
```

```
import { GOLEM_OBJECT_DATA } from './human/humanData.js';
import { HUMAN_ANIMATIONS } from './human/humanAnimations.js';
import { JawLinkage } from '../../core/animation/jawLinkage.js';

const TERRAIN_BASE_Y = -120.0;
const PLATEAU_HEIGHT = 80.0;

const TERRAIN_SCULPTS =[
    { center:[0, TERRAIN_BASE_Y, 0], radius: 6000, amount:[0, 200, 0], falloff: 'smooth' }, 
    { center:[0, 0, 0], radius: 450, amount: { axis: 1, value: PLATEAU_HEIGHT }, falloff: 'flatten' }

    [0, 0, 0, 180],

            id: 'physics_terrain',

                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 6 },
                ...TERRAIN_SCULPTS.map(s => ({ type: 'sculpt', params: s })),
                { type: 'smoothNormals' }
            ],
            shaderVars: { 
                uMaterialType: 'reflective', 
                uTexture: 'dirt', 
                uUseTriplanar: 1.0,

                uTextureScale: 0.02 
            },
            simulation: { type: 'static_collider' },
            keyframes:[{ time: 0, position:[0, 0, 0] }] 
        },
        {
            id: 'patchy_meadow',
            primitive: 'grass',
            parameters: { 
                count: 100000, 
                width: 800, 
                bladeHeight: 3.5, 
                seed: 770,
                patches: GRASS_PATCHES 
            },
            shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'grass' },
            keyframes:[{ time: 0, position:[0, PLATEAU_HEIGHT, 0] }]
        },
        {
            ...GOLEM_OBJECT_DATA,
            keyframes:[{ time: 0, position:[0, PLATEAU_HEIGHT + 25.0, 0], rotation:[0, 0, 0], scale:[1, 1, 1] }]

        const TARGET_ID = 'golem_manifest';
        
        // B"H - The UI now commands the Orator directly
        HumanUI.attach(renderer, orator);
        
        const originalUpdate = renderer.update.bind(renderer);
        renderer.update = (dt) => {
            originalUpdate(dt);
            
            // B"H - Orator orchestrates the lips, JawLinkage orchestrates the bones
            orator.update(dt, renderer, TARGET_ID);
            JawLinkage.sync(renderer, TARGET_ID);
        };
    }
};
```

```
            renderer.interactionController.disable();
        }
        
        renderer.interactionController = new InteractionController(renderer);
        renderer.interactionController.enable();

        if (renderer.transformController) {
            renderer.transformController.disable();
            console.log("B\"H - TransformController disabled for pure raycast test.");
        }

        // Static ray visualization
        const { Vec3 } = await import('../../core/math/vec3.js');
        
        const originObj = renderer.objectMap.get('ray_origin_marker');
        const targetObj = renderer.objectMap.get('ray_target_marker');
        const beamObj = renderer.objectMap.get('static_ray_beam');

        if (originObj && targetObj && beamObj) {
            const start = originObj.keyframes[0].position;
            const end = targetObj.keyframes[0].position;
            
            const dir = Vec3.normalize(Vec3.sub(end, start));
            const dist = Vec3.dist(start, end);
            const center = Vec3.lerp(start, end, 0.5);
            
            const pitch = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dir[1])));
            const yaw = Math.atan2(dir[0], dir[2]);
            
            beamObj.position = [...center];
            beamObj.rotation = [pitch, yaw, 0];
            beamObj.scale = [0.1, dist, 0.1];
            
            beamObj.visible = true;
            beamObj.dirty = true;
        }

        console.log("B\"H - 🔥 INSANE RAYCAST DEBUG SCENE READY 🔥");
        console.log("B\"H - Animations DISABLED. 8 interactive objects. Massive logging enabled.");
        console.log("B\"H - Click anywhere - every single bounding box will be logged.");
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testMarbleScene.js
 * @brief Column of spheres with jittered spawning for natural collision response.
 */
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: {
        "orbit": generateSpinTrack(120, 'y', [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1])
    },
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [40, 60, 100], 
        target: [0, 10, 0],
        animations: []
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uLightDirection: [0.5, 0.8, 0.4],
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.4, 0.4, 0.4],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.2, 1.2, 1.1],
    },
    objects: function() {
        const objects = [];
        const bowlSize = 80;
        
        // 1. The Large Container Bowl
        objects.push({
            id: 'marbleContainmentBowl',
            primitive: 'plane',
            parameters: { size: bowlSize, color: [0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 1.0] }, 
            modifiers: [
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 6 },
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [0,0,0], radius: 60, amount: [0, 45, 0], falloff: 'sharp' }, 
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [0,0,0], radius: 45, amount: [0, -25, 0], falloff: 'smooth' },
                { type: 'colorByHeight', min: -10, max: 25, colorLow: [0.05, 0.08, 0.1, 1], colorHigh: [0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 1] },
                { type: 'smoothNormals' },
                { type: 'makeDoubleSidedGeometry' } 
            ],
            simulation: { type: 'static_collider' },
            shaderVars: { uRoughness: 0.4, uMaterialType: 'reflective', uMetallic: 0.1 },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: [1, 1, 1] }]
        });
        
        // 2. Marbles - A Jittered Tower of Dropping Spheres
        const marbleCount = 50;
        for (let i = 0; i < marbleCount; i++) {
            // B"H - Added jitter (0.1) to prevent "perfect column" locking
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2; 
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
            const y = 45.0 + i * 2.2; 
            
            const palette = [
                [1, 0.1, 0.1], [0.1, 1, 0.1], [0.1, 0.3, 1], [1, 1, 0.1],
                [1, 0.1, 1], [0.1, 1, 1], [1, 0.5, 0.0], [0.5, 0.0, 1]
            ];
            const baseColor = palette[i % palette.length];
            const radius = 1.0; 
            
            objects.push({
                id: `marble_v_${i}`, primitive: 'sphere',
                parameters: { radius: radius, widthSegments: 24, heightSegments: 16, smooth: true },
                simulation: { 
                    type: 'rigid_body', 
                    config: { 
                        mass: 6.0, radius: radius, restitution: 0.5, friction: 0.01, 
                        initialPosition: [x, y, z], initialVelocity: [0, -15, 0] 
                    }
                },
                shaderVars: { 
                    uMaterialType: 'reflective', uRoughness: 0.01, uMetallic: 1.0, uBaseColor: baseColor 
                },
                keyframes: []
            });
        }
        
        return objects;
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testMetaballsScene.js
 * @brief Water Flow: A complex ground plane with a stump and paths for splitting.
 */
export const SCENE_DATA = {
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 500, 1000], 
        target: [0, 0, 0], 
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uLightDirection: [0.4, 1.0, 0.4],
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.4, 0.4, 0.5], 
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.8, 1.7, 1.6], 
    },
    objects: function() {
        const objects = [];
        const ballCount = 35; 
        const arenaSize = 2000;

        // 1. THE COMPLEX SCULPTED GROUND
        objects.push({
            id: 'complexGround',
            primitive: 'plane',
            parameters: { size: 1.0, color: [0.03, 0.04, 0.06, 1.0] }, 
            modifiers: [ 
                { type: 'scaleMesh', scale: [arenaSize, 1, arenaSize] },
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 6 }, 
                
                // A. THE STUMP (Central Bulge to SPLIT water)
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [0, 0, -250], radius: 100, amount: [0, 140, 0], falloff: 'dome' },

                // B. THE FURROWS (Paths for water to follow)
                // Path Left
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [-150, 0, 100], radius: 120, amount: [0, -120, 0], falloff: 'smooth' },
                // Path Right
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [150, 0, 100], radius: 120, amount: [0, -120, 0], falloff: 'smooth' },
                
                // C. THE POOLS (Basins at the end)
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [-250, 0, 500], radius: 300, amount: [0, -180, 0], falloff: 'smooth' },
                { type: 'sculpt', center: [250, 0, 500], radius: 300, amount: [0, -180, 0], falloff: 'smooth' },

                { type: 'smoothNormals' }
            ],
            simulation: { type: 'static_collider' },
            shaderVars: { 
                uMaterialType: 'reflective', uMetallic: 0.1, uRoughness: 0.35,
                uBaseColor: [0.1, 0.12, 0.15]
            },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0], rotation: [0,0,0], scale: [1,1,1] }]
        });

        // 2. THE CRYSTALLINE WATER FLUID
        objects.push({
            id: 'metaballSurface',
            primitive: 'none',
            isMetaballSurface: true,
            shaderVars: {
                uMaterialType: 'reflective', 
                uBaseColor: [0.0, 0.5, 1.0], // Azure Blue
                uMetallic: 0.5, uRoughness: 0.02
            },
            keyframes: []
        });

        // 3. WATER SOURCE (Dropping onto the Stump)
        for (let i = 0; i < ballCount; i++) {
            const jitter = 25.0;
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter;
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter - 250; // Over stump
            const y = 350.0 + i * 16.0; 
            const radius = 9.0; 
            
            objects.push({
                id: `metaball_driver_${i}`, 
                primitive: 'sphere',
                visible: false,
                isMetaballSource: true,
                simulation: { 
                    type: 'rigid_body', 
                    config: { 
                        mass: 16.0, radius: radius, restitution: 0.05, 
                        friction: 0.0, 
                        initialPosition: [x, y, z], initialVelocity: [0, -60, 0] 
                    }
                },
                keyframes: []
            });
        }
        
        return objects;
    }
};
```

```
// B"H
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';

/**
 * @file testNodeSculptScene.js
 * @brief A revelation of the JSON Node Tree displacement and Math selection logic.
 *        No hardcoded sculpting here—pure mathematical trees twist the form!
 */
export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: {
        "orbit": generateSpinTrack(30, 'y')
    },
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 8, 20],
        target: [0, 2, 0],
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.2, 0.2, 0.3],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.2, 1.0, 0.8],
        uLightDirection: [0.5, 1.0, 0.5],
    },
    objects: [
        {
            id: 'node_driven_artifact',
            primitive: 'icosphere',
            parameters: { radius: 4.0, subdivisions: 4, smooth: true },
            modifiers: [
                // B"H - Export semantic poles for selection logic
                { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'all', pointName: 'north_pole', axis: 'y', direction: 1 } },
                { type: 'exportBounds', params: { tag: 'all', pointName: 'south_pole', axis: 'y', direction: -1 } },

                // B"H - Node Sculpt: Create rippling sine waves over the surface
                {
                    type: 'nodeSculpt',
                    params: {
                        query: { all: true }, // Select everything
                        tree: {
                            // Multiply Normal by Math.sin(pos.y * 5.0) * 0.5
                            op: 'mul',
                            left: { var: 'norm' }, // The direction of displacement
                            right: {
                                op: 'mul',
                                left: {
                                    op: 'sin',
                                    arg: { op: 'mul', left: { var: 'pos.y' }, right: 5.0 }
                                },
                                right: 0.5
                            }
                        },
                        colorTree: {
                            // Make it glow based on height: mix(Blue, Red, pos.y * 0.1)
                            op: 'vec3',
                            x: { op: 'add', left: 0.2, right: { op: 'mul', left: { var: 'pos.y' }, right: 0.2 } },
                            y: 0.4,
                            z: { op: 'sub', left: 1.0, right: { op: 'mul', left: { var: 'pos.y' }, right: 0.2 } }
                        }
                    }
                },
                
                // B"H - Semantic Cylinder Extrusion: Extrude ONLY the middle stalk connecting poles
                {
                    type: 'extrudeFaces',
                    params: {
                        query: { semanticCylinder: { startPoint: 'north_pole', endPoint: 'south_pole', radius: 1.5 } },
                        distance: 0.5,
                        scale: 0.8
                    }
                },

                { type: 'smoothNormals' }
            ],
            shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'reflective', uMetallic: 0.8, uRoughness: 0.2 },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 2, 0] }],
            animations: [{ track: "orbit", speed: 1.0 }]
        },
        {
            id: 'ground',
            primitive: 'grid',
            parameters: { size: 40, divisions: 20 },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -3, 0] }]
        }
    ]
};
```

### File: `tests/scenes/testSculptingSystem.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file testSculptingSystem.js
 * @brief A grand demonstration of the new, powerful text-based sculpting and selection systems.
 * 
 * THE HYMN OF THE SCULPTED WORD:
 * The hand of the artist, now guided by text,
 * Commands the points of creation, no longer perplexed.
 * A gaze from the front pulls a face from the cube,
 * A ring is selected, a new form to include.
 * A walk on the surface, a pathway defined,
 * A mountain range rises, from a single straight line.
 * With logic and reason, the matter is carved,
 * The Will of the Essence is perfectly served.
 */
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: {
        "slowSpin": generateSpinTrack(25, 'y'),
    },
    camera: {
        initialPosition: [0, 15, 30],
        target: [0, 2, 0],
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.3, 0.3, 0.4],
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.1, 1.1, 1.0],
        uLightDirection: [0.5, 1.0, 0.5]
    },
    objects: [
        // 1. Projected Box Selection (Simulated Orthographic View)
        {
            id: 'projectedBoxCube',
            primitive: 'cube',
            parameters: { size: 4.0 },
            modifiers: [
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 3 },
                { 
                    type: 'defineShapeKey', 
                    params: {
                        name: 'pull_front',
                        // Select all vertices on the front face, regardless of depth
                        query: { projectedBox: { axis: 'z', min: [-1.8, -1.8], max: [1.8, 1.8] } },
                        sculpt: {
                            center: [0, 0, 2.1],
                            radius: 3.0,
                            amount: [0, 0, 2.5],
                            falloff: 'smooth'
                        }
                    }
                }
            ],
            shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'lambert', uBaseColor: [0.2, 0.8, 0.6] },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [-10, 2, 0] }],
            animations: [{ track: "slowSpin", speed: 1.0 }]
        },
        // 2. Ring/Segment & Boolean Selection
        {
            id: 'ringSelectSphere',
            primitive: 'uvSphere',
            parameters: { radius: 2.5, rings: 24, segments: 32 },
            modifiers: [
                // A. Expand the equator
                { 
                    type: 'defineShapeKey', 
                    params: {
                        name: 'expand_equator',
                        query: { ring: 12 },
                        sculpt: { center: [0,0,0], radius: 3.0, amount: [0.8, 0, 0.8], falloff: 'smooth' }
                    }
                },
                // B. Create a crescent using AND/NOT
                {
                    type: 'defineShapeKey',
                    params: {
                        name: 'crescent_cut',
                        query: { 
                            and: [
                                { sphere: { center: [0, 0, 0], radius: 2.6 } },
                                { not: { sphere: { center: [1.5, 0, 0], radius: 2.0 } } }
                            ]
                        },
                        sculpt: { center: [0,0,0], radius: 3.0, amount: [0, 0, -1.5], falloff: 'smooth' }
                    }
                }
            ],
            shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'lambert', uBaseColor: [0.8, 0.2, 0.6] },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 2.5, 0] }],
            animations: [{ track: "slowSpin", speed: -1.2 }]
        },
        // 3. Topological Walk Selection
        {
            id: 'walkSelectPlane',
            primitive: 'plane',
            parameters: { size: 10 },
            modifiers: [
                { type: 'subdivide', levels: 5 }, // 32x32 grid
                {
                    type: 'defineShapeKey',
                    params: {
                        name: 'ridge',
                        query: {
                            walk: {
                                startQuery: { box: { min: [-5, -0.1, -0.1], max: [-4.9, 0.1, 0.1] } },
                                steps: 30,
                                direction: [0.5, 0, 0.8] // Walk diagonally
                            }
                        },
                        sculpt: { center: [0,0,0], radius: 2.0, amount: [0, 1.5, 0], falloff: 'smooth' }
                    }
                }
            ],
            shaderVars: { uMaterialType: 'lambert', uBaseColor: [0.8, 0.8, 0.2] },
```

```
// B"H
import { create3DText } from '../../core/text/text3D.js';

export const SCENE_DATA = {
    tracks: {},
    camera: { 
        initialPosition: [0, 5, 50], 
        target: [0, 0, 0] 
    },
    sky: { enabled: true },
    globalShaderVars: {
        uAmbientLightColor: [0.4, 0.4, 0.45], 
        uDirectionalLightColor: [1.0, 0.95, 0.9], 
        uLightDirection: [0.3, 0.5, 1.0] 
    },
    objects: function() {
        const root = {
            id: 'text_root',
            primitive: 'none',
            children: [],
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, 0, 0] }]
        };

        // B"H - The "Load Font" button has been removed for purity and simplicity.
        const existingBtn = document.getElementById('font-load-btn');
        if (existingBtn) existingBtn.remove();
        
        // Generate Text using the default, reliable canvas method.
        console.log("B\"H - Creating 3D Text Object...");
        const textObj = create3DText("Shalom Olam", {
            depth: 4,
            color: [1.0, 0.85, 0.4, 1.0] 
        });
        
        // Add reflective material properties to each generated glyph
        if (textObj.children) {
            textObj.children.forEach(c => {
                c.shaderVars = {
                    uMaterialType: 'reflective',
                    uBaseColor: [1.0, 0.8, 0.2],
                    uMetallic: 0.8,
                    uRoughness: 0.2
                };
            });
        }

        root.children.push(textObj);
        
        // Add a ground plane for context
        root.children.push({
            id: 'floor',
            primitive: 'grid',
            parameters: { size: 100, divisions: 20, color: [0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1] },
            keyframes: [{ time: 0, position: [0, -10, 0], rotation: [0, 0, 0] }]
        });

        return [root];
    }
};
```

### File: `tests/scenes/testWheelScene.js`

```
// B"H
import { generateSpinTrack } from '../../core/animation/keyframeUtils.js';

// Helper to generate modifiers for extruding all side faces of a cylinder
function generateWheelModifiers(radialSegments, extrusionAmount) {
    const modifiers = [];
    
    // In createCylinderMesh, the side faces are generated first.
    // There are 'radialSegments' number of side faces (if heightSegments is 1).
    // They occupy indices 0 to radialSegments-1.
    
    for (let i = 0; i < radialSegments; i++) {
        modifiers.push({
            type: 'extrude',
            face: i, // The index of the face to extrude
            amount: extrusionAmount
        });
        
        // Optional: Color the extruded tips differently
        modifiers.push({
            type: 'setFaceColor',
            face: i, // After extrusion, the 'cap' (tip) keeps the original index
            color: [0.8, 0.3, 0.2, 1.0] // Reddish tips
        });

        // Optional: Scale the tip to make it spikey or gear-like
        modifiers.push({
            type: 'scaleFace',
            face: i,
            amount: 0.8
        });
    }
    return modifiers;
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file domManifestor.js
 * @brief Translates pure JSON schema into living DOM elements.
 *        Reflects how abstract thought descends into physical reality.
 */

export class DOMManifestor {
    static create(schema) {
        if (!schema) return null;
        if (typeof schema === 'string' || typeof schema === 'number') {
            return document.createTextNode(String(schema));
        }

        const el = document.createElement(schema.tag || 'div');
        
        if (schema.id) el.id = schema.id;
        if (schema.cls) el.className = schema.cls;
        if (schema.text) el.textContent = schema.text;
        if (schema.html) el.innerHTML = schema.html;
        
        if (schema.style) {
            Object.assign(el.style, schema.style);
        }
        
        if (schema.attrs) {
            Object.entries(schema.attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => el.setAttribute(k, v));
        }
        
        if (schema.events) {
            Object.entries(schema.events).forEach(([k, v]) => el.addEventListener(k, v));
        }

        if (schema.children && Array.isArray(schema.children)) {
            schema.children.forEach(childSchema => {
                const childEl = this.create(childSchema);
                if (childEl) el.appendChild(childEl);
            });
        }

        return el;
    }
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file controls.js
 * @brief Creates and manages the main toggle buttons in the UI.
 */

function createBtn(id, text, initialState, onClick) {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.id = id;
    btn.textContent = text;
    
    let isActive = initialState;

    const updateStyle = () => {
        if (isActive) {
            btn.style.background = 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.2)';
            btn.style.color = '#00ffcc';
            btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.6)';
        } else {
            btn.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
            btn.style.color = '#888';
            btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
        }
    };
    updateStyle();
    
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        isActive = !isActive;
        onClick(isActive);
        updateStyle();
    });
    return btn;
}

export function createToggleControls(container, callbacks) {
    if (!container) return;

    const cameraBtn = createBtn('camera-anim-toggle', 'Camera Anim: ON', true, (enabled) => {
        cameraBtn.textContent = `Camera Anim: ${enabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`;
        callbacks.onCameraAnimToggle(enabled);
    });

    const shadowBtn = createBtn('shadow-toggle', 'Shadows: ON', true, (enabled) => {
        shadowBtn.textContent = `Shadows: ${enabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`;
        callbacks.onShadowsToggle(enabled);
    });

    const wireframeBtn = createBtn('wireframe-toggle', 'Wireframe: OFF', false, (enabled) => {
        wireframeBtn.textContent = `Wireframe: ${enabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`;
        callbacks.onWireframesToggle(enabled);
    });
    
    container.appendChild(cameraBtn);
    container.appendChild(shadowBtn);
    container.appendChild(wireframeBtn);
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file console.js
 * @brief Manages console logging and copy-to-clipboard functionality.
 */

export function setupConsole(dom) {
    if (!dom.copyButton) return;

    dom.copyButton.addEventListener('click', () => copyLogs(dom));
}

export function addLog(dom, type, message) {
    if (!dom.consoleLogArea) return;
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.classList.add(`log-${type}`);
    div.textContent = message;
    dom.consoleLogArea.appendChild(div);
    dom.consoleLogArea.scrollTop = dom.consoleLogArea.scrollHeight;
}

export function copyLogs(dom) {
    if (!dom.consoleLogArea) return;
    const txt = Array.from(dom.consoleLogArea.children).map(c => c.textContent).join('\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => addLog(dom, 'info', 'Logs copied.'));
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file customComponents.js
 * @brief Parses JSON-based UI descriptions into actual DOM elements.
 */

export function buildCustomUI(schemaArray, container) {
    if (!schemaArray || !Array.isArray(schemaArray)) return;

    // Wrap custom UI in a stylish collapsible section if it's not empty
    if (schemaArray.length === 0) return;

    const section = document.createElement('div');
    section.className = 'collapsible-section';

    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'collapsible-header';
    header.innerHTML = `
        <span class="script-selection-label">Scene Controls</span>
        <span class="collapse-arrow">▼</span>
    `;

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'controls-wrapper scene-controls-wrapper';

    header.addEventListener('click', () => {
        section.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        wrapper.style.display = section.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'none' : 'flex';
    });

    schemaArray.forEach(schema => {
        const el = createComponent(schema);
        if (el) wrapper.appendChild(el);
    });

    section.appendChild(header);
    section.appendChild(wrapper);
    container.appendChild(section);
}

function createComponent(schema) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.style.display = 'flex';
    row.style.flexDirection = 'column';
    row.style.gap = '4px';

    if (schema.type === 'slider') {
        if (schema.label) {
            const label = document.createElement('label');
            label.textContent = schema.label;
            label.style.fontSize = '11px';
            label.style.color = '#fff';
            row.appendChild(label);
        }

        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'range';
        input.min = schema.min !== undefined ? schema.min : 0;
        input.max = schema.max !== undefined ? schema.max : 100;
        input.step = schema.step !== undefined ? schema.step : 1;
        input.value = schema.value !== undefined ? schema.value : 50;
        input.id = schema.id || '';
        if (schema.onChange) {
            input.addEventListener('input', (e) => schema.onChange(parseFloat(e.target.value)));
        }
        row.appendChild(input);

    } else if (schema.type === 'button') {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = schema.label || 'Button';
        btn.id = schema.id || '';
        if (schema.onClick) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', schema.onClick);
        }
        row.appendChild(btn);

    } else if (schema.type === 'checkbox') {
        const wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.style.display = 'flex';
        wrap.style.alignItems = 'center';
        wrap.style.gap = '8px';

        const cb = document.createElement('input');
        cb.type = 'checkbox';
        cb.checked = !!schema.checked;
        cb.id = schema.id || '';

        const lbl = document.createElement('label');
        lbl.textContent = schema.label || '';
        lbl.style.fontSize = '11px';
        lbl.style.color = '#fff';

        if (schema.onChange) {
            cb.addEventListener('change', (e) => schema.onChange(e.target.checked));
        }

        wrap.appendChild(cb);
        wrap.appendChild(lbl);
        row.appendChild(wrap);

    } else if (schema.type === 'html') {
        row.innerHTML = schema.html || '';
    } else {
        return null;
    }

    return row;
}
```

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file cosmosUI.js
 * @chapter THE ETERNAL MEMORY OF THE HEAVENS
 * 
 * THE PSALM OF THE REMEMBERED SPHERES:
 * "Forever, Lord, Your Word stands in the heavens."
 * And so too shall the settings of the celestial bodies stand!
 * When the page refreshes, the Longitude and Latitude are drawn from Local Storage,
 * Preserving the user's cosmic symphony intact!
 * 
 * @module CosmosUI
 */

const STORAGE_KEY = "AWTSMOOS_COSMOS_STATE_V3";

export function setupCosmosUI(container) {
    if (!container) return;

    // 1. RECLAIM THE MEMORY
    const savedStateStr = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    const defaultState = {
        sunLat: 20, sunLon: -40,
        moonLat: 15, moonLon: 120, 
        mercuryLat: 15, mercuryLon: -50,
        venusLat: 25, venusLon: -30,
        marsLat: 60, marsLon: 90,
        jupiterLat: 45, jupiterLon: -120,
        saturnLat: 30, saturnLon: 180,
        ninthSphereRot: 0.0, 
        eighthSphereRot: 0.0, 
        cloudDensity: 0.2,
        sunIntensity: 0.6 
    };

    if (!window.__COSMOS_STATE__) {
        if (savedStateStr) {
            try {
                window.__COSMOS_STATE__ = JSON.parse(savedStateStr);
                // Ensure new defaults are merged if older cache existed
                for (const key in defaultState) {
                    if (window.__COSMOS_STATE__[key] === undefined) {
                        window.__COSMOS_STATE__[key] = defaultState[key];
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {
                window.__COSMOS_STATE__ = defaultState;
            }
        } else {
            window.__COSMOS_STATE__ = defaultState;
        }
    }

    const state = window.__COSMOS_STATE__;

    const saveState = () => {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(window.__COSMOS_STATE__));
    };

    const section = document.createElement('div');
    section.className = 'collapsible-section';
    
    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'collapsible-header';
    header.innerHTML = '<span class="label">Rambam\'s 9 Spheres</span><span class="arrow">▼</span>';
    
    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'controls-wrapper';
    
    header.onclick = () => {
        section.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        wrapper.style.display = section.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'none' : 'flex';
    };

    const createSlider = (labelTxt, min, max, step, key, onChange) => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 6px;';
        
        const label = document.createElement('label');
        label.textContent = `${labelTxt}: ${state[key]}`;
        label.style.cssText = 'font-size: 10px; color: #ccc;';
        
        const slider = document.createElement('input');
        slider.type = 'range'; slider.min = min; slider.max = max; slider.step = step; 
        slider.value = state[key];
        
        slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const val = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            label.textContent = `${labelTxt}: ${val}`;
            state[key] = val;
            saveState(); // B"H - Eternal Persistance
            if (onChange) onChange(val);
        });
        
        row.appendChild(label); row.appendChild(slider); return row;
    };

    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Sun Intensity', 0.1, 2.0, 0.01, 'sunIntensity'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Sphere 9 (Diurnal All)', -1440, 1440, 1, 'ninthSphereRot'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Sphere 8 (Stars Only)', -1440, 1440, 1, 'eighthSphereRot'));
    
    // Sun and Moon (Spheres 4 and 1)
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Sun Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'sunLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Sun Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'sunLon'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Moon Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'moonLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Moon Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'moonLon'));
    
    // The other planets
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Mercury Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'mercuryLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Mercury Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'mercuryLon'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Venus Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'venusLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Venus Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'venusLon'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Mars Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'marsLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Mars Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'marsLon'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Jupiter Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'jupiterLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Jupiter Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'jupiterLon'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Saturn Latitude', -90, 90, 1, 'saturnLat'));
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Saturn Longitude', -360, 360, 1, 'saturnLon'));
    
    // Earth Atmosphere
    wrapper.appendChild(createSlider('Cloud Density', 0, 1, 0.01, 'cloudDensity'));

    section.appendChild(header); section.appendChild(wrapper); container.appendChild(section);
}
```

```
// B"H
export class Logger {
    uiManager; originalConsole = {};
    constructor(uiManager) {
        this.uiManager = uiManager;
        this.originalConsole.log = console.log;
        this.originalConsole.warn = console.warn;
        this.originalConsole.error = console.error;
    }
    init() {
        if (!this.uiManager) return;
        const self = this;
        console.log = function(...args) {
            self.originalConsole.log(...args);
            self.uiManager.addLog('info', args.map(String).join(' '));
        };
        console.warn = function(...args) {
            self.originalConsole.warn(...args);
            self.uiManager.addLog('warn', 'WARNING: ' + args.map(String).join(' '));
        };
        console.error = function(...args) {
            self.originalConsole.error(...args);
            self.uiManager.addLog('error', 'ERROR: ' + args.map(String).join(' '));
        };
    }
}
```
