```
// B"H
import { DOMManifestor } from './core/domManifestor.js';
import { setupConsole, addLog } from './console.js';
import { setupCosmosUI } from './cosmosUI.js'; 

export class UIManager {
    dom = {};
    isPanelVisible = true;
    isLogVisible = false;

    onCameraAnimToggle = null;
    onShadowsToggle = null;
    onWireframesToggle = null;
    onSkeletonToggle = null;
    onPlayModeToggle = null;

    init(containerId) {
        const root = document.getElementById(containerId);
        if (!root) return;
        this.buildBaseUI(root);
        this.dom = {
            container: root,
            consolePanel: document.getElementById('console-panel'),
            consoleLogArea: document.getElementById('console-log-area'),
            controlsArea: document.getElementById('console-controls'),
            toggleButton: document.getElementById('console-toggle-button'),
            copyButton: document.getElementById('copy-log-button'),
            hideLogButtonInner: document.getElementById('hide-log-button-inner'),
            testScriptListElement: document.getElementById('test-scripts-list'),
            customControlsArea: document.getElementById('custom-controls-area')
        };
        
        setupCosmosUI(this.dom.controlsArea);
        this.setupInteractivity();
        setupConsole(this.dom);
        
        if (!this.isLogVisible) this.dom.consoleLogArea.classList.add('log-hidden');
    }

    buildBaseUI(root) {
        const createBtn = (id, text) => ({ tag: 'button', id, cls: 'action-btn', text });
        const schema = {
            tag: 'div', id: 'ui-layer',
            children:[
                { tag: 'button', id: 'console-toggle-button', text: 'Hide UI', cls: 'main-toggle-btn' },
                {
                    tag: 'div', id: 'console-panel', cls: 'panel',
                    children:[
                        { tag: 'div', id: 'console-log-area', cls: 'log-area' },
                        {
                            tag: 'div', id: 'console-controls', cls: 'controls-area',
                            children:[
                                {
                                    tag: 'div', cls: 'collapsible-section',
                                    children:[
                                        { tag: 'div', cls: 'collapsible-header', html: '<span class="label">General</span><span class="arrow">▼</span>' },
                                        { tag: 'div', cls: 'controls-wrapper', children:[
                                            createBtn('play-mode-toggle', 'ENTER PLAY MODE'),
                                            createBtn('copy-log-button', 'Copy Logs'),
                                            createBtn('hide-log-button-inner', 'Show Logs'), 
                                            createBtn('camera-anim-toggle', 'Camera Anim: ON'),
                                            createBtn('shadow-toggle', 'Shadows: ON'),
                                            createBtn('wireframe-toggle', 'Wireframe: OFF'),
                                            createBtn('skeleton-toggle', 'Skeleton: OFF')
                                        ]}
                                    ]
                                },
                                {
                                    tag: 'div', cls: 'collapsible-section',
                                    children:[
                                        { tag: 'div', cls: 'collapsible-header', html: '<span class="label">Test Scenes</span><span class="arrow">▼</span>' },
                                        { tag: 'ul', id: 'test-scripts-list', cls: 'scene-list' }
                                    ]
                                },
                                { tag: 'div', id: 'custom-controls-area' }
                            ]
                        }
                    ]
                }
            ]
        };
        root.appendChild(DOMManifestor.create(schema));
    }

    setupInteractivity() {
        this.dom.toggleButton.onclick = () => {
            this.isPanelVisible = !this.isPanelVisible;
            this.dom.consolePanel.classList.toggle('hidden', !this.isPanelVisible);
            this.dom.toggleButton.textContent = this.isPanelVisible ? 'Hide UI' : 'Show UI';
        };

        this.dom.hideLogButtonInner.onclick = () => {
            this.isLogVisible = !this.isLogVisible;
            this.dom.consoleLogArea.classList.toggle('log-hidden', !this.isLogVisible);
            this.dom.hideLogButtonInner.textContent = this.isLogVisible ? 'Hide Logs' : 'Show Logs';
        };

        const bindToggle = (id, textBase, defaultState, callback) => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!btn) return;
            let state = defaultState;
            const update = () => {
                btn.textContent = `${textBase}: ${state ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`;
                btn.style.borderColor = state ? 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.6)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
                if(textBase === 'PLAY MODE') {
                    btn.style.background = state ? 'rgba(0,255,100,0.3)' : 'transparent';
                }
            };
            if (textBase !== 'PLAY MODE') update(); 
            
            btn.onclick = () => { state = !state; update(); callback?.(state); };
        };

        bindToggle('camera-anim-toggle', 'Camera Anim', true, s => this.onCameraAnimToggle?.(s));
        bindToggle('shadow-toggle', 'Shadows', true, s => this.onShadowsToggle?.(s));
        bindToggle('wireframe-toggle', 'Wireframe', false, s => this.onWireframesToggle?.(s));
        bindToggle('skeleton-toggle', 'Skeleton', false, s => this.onSkeletonToggle?.(s));
        
        const playBtn = document.getElementById('play-mode-toggle');
        let playState = false;
        playBtn.onclick = () => {
            playState = !playState;
            playBtn.textContent = playState ? "EXIT PLAY MODE" : "ENTER PLAY MODE";
            playBtn.style.color = playState ? "#ff0055" : "#00ffcc";
            playBtn.style.borderColor = playState ? "#ff0055" : "rgba(0,255,204,0.4)";
            this.onPlayModeToggle?.(playState);
        };

        document.querySelectorAll('.collapsible-header').forEach(header => {
            header.onclick = () => header.closest('.collapsible-section').classList.toggle('collapsed');
        });
    }

    addLog(type, message) { addLog(this.dom, type, message); }
    setTestScripts(names, callback) {
        if (!this.dom.testScriptListElement) return;
        this.dom.testScriptListElement.innerHTML = '';
        names.forEach(name => {
            this.dom.testScriptListElement.appendChild(DOMManifestor.create({
                tag: 'li', cls: 'test-script-item', text: name,
                events: { click: () => { callback(name); } }
            }));
        });
    }

    setCameraAnimCallback(cb) { this.onCameraAnimToggle = cb; }
    setShadowsCallback(cb) { this.onShadowsToggle = cb; }
    setWireframesCallback(cb) { this.onWireframesToggle = cb; }
    setSkeletonCallback(cb) { this.onSkeletonToggle = cb; }
    setPlayModeCallback(cb) { this.onPlayModeToggle = cb; }

    clearCustomControls() { if (this.dom.customControlsArea) this.dom.customControlsArea.innerHTML = ''; }
    addCustomControl(element) { if (this.dom.customControlsArea) this.dom.customControlsArea.appendChild(element); }
}
```

### File: `ui/domElements.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file domElements.js
 * @brief Gathers and returns references to all essential UI DOM elements.
 */
export function getDOMElements() {
    return {
        container: document.getElementById('ui-container'),

        consoleLogArea: document.getElementById('console-log-area'),
```

### File: `raycastSystem.js`

```
/**
 * B"H
 * RaycastSystem - World-Space AABB Raycast
 * 
 * Root cause of all failures: bounding boxes were stored and tested
 * in LOCAL space. Ray is in WORLD space. They must match.
 */

export class RaycastSystem {
    constructor(sceneManager) {
        this.sceneManager = sceneManager;
        this._tempMin = new Float32Array(3);
        this._tempMax = new Float32Array(3);
    }

    /**
     * Compute world-space AABB for a mesh node.
     * Walks the node's worldMatrix (or position/scale/rotation)
     * to transform local min/max into world space.
     * 
     * @param {object} node - scene mesh node with .geometry or .vertices
     * @returns {{ min: Float32Array, max: Float32Array } | null}
     */
    computeWorldAABB(node) {
        // --- 1. Get local-space bounds from raw vertex positions ---
        const positions = node._localPositions || node.vertices || node.geometry?.positions;
        if (!positions || positions.length < 3) {
            console.warn(`B"H - RaycastSystem: No positions for [${node.name}]`);
            return null;
        }

        let lMinX =  Infinity, lMinY =  Infinity, lMinZ =  Infinity;
        let lMaxX = -Infinity, lMaxY = -Infinity, lMaxZ = -Infinity;

        // positions is a flat Float32Array: [x0,y0,z0, x1,y1,z1, ...]
        for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
            const x = positions[i    ];
            const y = positions[i + 1];
            const z = positions[i + 2];
            if (x < lMinX) lMinX = x;  if (x > lMaxX) lMaxX = x;
            if (y < lMinY) lMinY = y;  if (y > lMaxY) lMaxY = y;
            if (z < lMinZ) lMinZ = z;  if (z > lMaxZ) lMaxZ = z;
        }

        // --- 2. Get the node's world matrix ---
        // Support both a full 4x4 worldMatrix and a simple position+scale
        const wm = node.worldMatrix; // column-major Float32Array[16], optional

        let wMinX, wMinY, wMinZ, wMaxX, wMaxY, wMaxZ;

        if (wm) {
            // Transform all 8 corners of the local AABB by the world matrix,
            // then take the min/max of the transformed corners.
            // This handles rotation correctly.
            wMinX =  Infinity; wMinY =  Infinity; wMinZ =  Infinity;
            wMaxX = -Infinity; wMaxY = -Infinity; wMaxZ = -Infinity;

            const cornersX = [lMinX, lMaxX];
            const cornersY = [lMinY, lMaxY];
            const cornersZ = [lMinZ, lMaxZ];

            for (let ci = 0; ci < 8; ci++) {
                const lx = cornersX[(ci >> 0) & 1];
                const ly = cornersY[(ci >> 1) & 1];
                const lz = cornersZ[(ci >> 2) & 1];

                // Column-major 4x4: m[col*4 + row]
                // World position = M * [lx, ly, lz, 1]
                const wx = wm[0]*lx + wm[4]*ly + wm[8] *lz + wm[12];
                const wy = wm[1]*lx + wm[5]*ly + wm[9] *lz + wm[13];
                const wz = wm[2]*lx + wm[6]*ly + wm[10]*lz + wm[14];

                if (wx < wMinX) wMinX = wx;  if (wx > wMaxX) wMaxX = wx;
                if (wy < wMinY) wMinY = wy;  if (wy > wMaxY) wMaxY = wy;
                if (wz < wMinZ) wMinZ = wz;  if (wz > wMaxZ) wMaxZ = wz;
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback: use position + scale directly (no rotation)
            const px = node.position?.[0] ?? node.worldPosition?.[0] ?? 0;
            const py = node.position?.[1] ?? node.worldPosition?.[1] ?? 0;
            const pz = node.position?.[2] ?? node.worldPosition?.[2] ?? 0;
            const sx = node.scale?.[0] ?? 1;
            const sy = node.scale?.[1] ?? 1;
            const sz = node.scale?.[2] ?? 1;

            wMinX = lMinX * sx + px;
            wMinY = lMinY * sy + py;
            wMinZ = lMinZ * sz + pz;
            wMaxX = lMaxX * sx + px;
            wMaxY = lMaxY * sy + py;
            wMaxZ = lMaxZ * sz + pz;

            // Ensure min < max after scale (negative scale flips them)
            if (wMinX > wMaxX) { const t = wMinX; wMinX = wMaxX; wMaxX = t; }
            if (wMinY > wMaxY) { const t = wMinY; wMinY = wMaxY; wMaxY = t; }
            if (wMinZ > wMaxZ) { const t = wMinZ; wMinZ = wMaxZ; wMaxZ = t; }
        }

        return {
            min: [wMinX, wMinY, wMinZ],
            max: [wMaxX, wMaxY, wMaxZ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Ray vs AABB slab test.
     * Ray: origin + t*direction
     * Returns t of first intersection, or -1 if miss.
     * Epsilon guards against edge grazes and float precision issues.
     *
     * @param {number[]} ro  - ray origin    [x, y, z]
     * @param {number[]} rd  - ray direction [x, y, z] (need not be normalized)
     * @param {number[]} bMin - AABB min      [x, y, z]
     * @param {number[]} bMax - AABB max      [x, y, z]
     * @returns {number} t >= 0 on hit, -1 on miss
     */
    rayAABB(ro, rd, bMin, bMax) {
        const EPSILON = 1e-8;

        let tMin = -Infinity;
        let tMax =  Infinity;

        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            const d = rd[i];
            const o = ro[i];
            const blo = bMin[i];
            const bhi = bMax[i];

            if (Math.abs(d) < EPSILON) {
                // Ray parallel to slab: origin must be inside
                if (o < blo || o > bhi) return -1;
            } else {
                const invD = 1.0 / d;
                let t1 = (blo - o) * invD;
                let t2 = (bhi - o) * invD;
                if (t1 > t2) { const tmp = t1; t1 = t2; t2 = tmp; }
                tMin = Math.max(tMin, t1);
                tMax = Math.min(tMax, t2);
                if (tMin > tMax) return -1;
            }
        }

        // tMax < 0 means AABB is behind the ray
        if (tMax < 0) return -1;

        // Return the first positive t
        return tMin >= 0 ? tMin : tMax;
    }

    /**
     * Cast a ray through the scene.
     * Returns the closest hit node, or null.
     *
     * @param {number[]} rayOrigin    - world-space [x,y,z]
     * @param {number[]} rayDirection - world-space [x,y,z] (normalized)
     * @param {string[]} [excludeNames] - node names to skip (e.g. ray visualizer meshes)
     * @returns {{ node: object, t: number, hitPoint: number[] } | null}
     */
    castRay(rayOrigin, rayDirection, excludeNames = []) {
        const SKIP = new Set([
            'debug_ray_beam', 'static_ray_beam',
            'ray_origin_marker', 'ray_target_marker',
            'majestic_metal_grid',
            ...excludeNames
        ]);

        const nodes = this.sceneManager.getAllNodes?.() 
                   ?? this.sceneManager.scene?.nodes 
                   ?? [];

        let closestT = Infinity;
        let closestNode = null;

        for (const node of nodes) {
            if (SKIP.has(node.name)) continue;

            const aabb = this.computeWorldAABB(node);
            if (!aabb) {
                console.warn(`B"H - RaycastSystem: Skipping [${node.name}] — no AABB`);
                continue;
            }

            console.log(
                `B"H - RaycastSystem: Testing [${node.name}]\n` +
                `  World MIN: [${aabb.min.map(v=>v.toFixed(3)).join(', ')}]\n` +
                `  World MAX: [${aabb.max.map(v=>v.toFixed(3)).join(', ')}]`
            );

            const t = this.rayAABB(rayOrigin, rayDirection, aabb.min, aabb.max);

            if (t >= 0 && t < closestT) {
                closestT = t;
                closestNode = node;
            }
        }

        if (!closestNode) return null;

        const hitPoint = [
            rayOrigin[0] + rayDirection[0] * closestT,
            rayOrigin[1] + rayDirection[1] * closestT,
            rayOrigin[2] + rayDirection[2] * closestT,
        ];

        console.log(
            `B"H - RaycastSystem: ✅ HIT [${closestNode.name}] ` +
            `at t=${closestT.toFixed(3)}, ` +
            `point=[${hitPoint.map(v=>v.toFixed(3)).join(', ')}]`
        );

        return { node: closestNode, t: closestT, hitPoint };
    }

    /**
     * Unproject a screen click into a world-space ray.
     * 
     * CRITICAL: canvas offset must be subtracted from event coords.
     * CRITICAL: projectionMatrix and viewMatrix must be current-frame values.
     *
     * @param {MouseEvent} event
     * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
     * @param {Float32Array} projMatrix  - column-major 4x4
     * @param {Float32Array} viewMatrix  - column-major 4x4 (world→camera)
     * @returns {{ origin: number[], direction: number[] }}
     */
    screenToRay(event, canvas, projMatrix, viewMatrix) {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const dpr  = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

        // NDC: [-1, 1] x [-1, 1]
        // Note: do NOT multiply by dpr here — clientX/Y are CSS pixels,
        // matching getBoundingClientRect which is also in CSS pixels.
        const ndcX =  ((event.clientX - rect.left ) / rect.width ) * 2 - 1;
        const ndcY = -((event.clientY - rect.top  ) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

        // Unproject: clip → view → world
        // clip-space ray direction (near plane): [ndcX, ndcY, -1, 1]
        // We need the inverse of projMatrix to go clip→view,
        // then inverse of viewMatrix to go view→world.

        const invProj = this._invertMat4(projMatrix);
        const invView = this._invertMat4(viewMatrix);

        // View-space ray direction
        const rayViewX = invProj[0]*ndcX + invProj[4]*ndcY + invProj[8]*(-1) + invProj[12];
        const rayViewY = invProj[1]*ndcX + invProj[5]*ndcY + invProj[9]*(-1) + invProj[13];
        const rayViewZ = invProj[2]*ndcX + invProj[6]*ndcY + invProj[10]*(-1) + invProj[14];
        const rayViewW = invProj[3]*ndcX + invProj[7]*ndcY + invProj[11]*(-1) + invProj[15];

        // Perspective divide, set w=0 for direction (not position)
        const vx = rayViewW !== 0 ? rayViewX / rayViewW : rayViewX;
        const vy = rayViewW !== 0 ? rayViewY / rayViewW : rayViewY;
        const vz = -1.0; // Always pointing into screen in view space
        // w = 0 means direction (not affected by translation in world transform)

        // World-space ray direction
        const wx = invView[0]*vx + invView[4]*vy + invView[8] *vz;
        const wy = invView[1]*vx + invView[5]*vy + invView[9] *vz;
        const wz = invView[2]*vx + invView[6]*vy + invView[10]*vz;

        const len = Math.sqrt(wx*wx + wy*wy + wz*wz);
        const direction = len > 0
            ? [wx/len, wy/len, wz/len]
            : [0, 0, -1];

        // Camera world position = translation column of invView
        const origin = [invView[12], invView[13], invView[14]];

        console.log(
            `B"H - RaycastSystem: screenToRay\n` +
            `  Screen: (${event.clientX.toFixed(0)}, ${event.clientY.toFixed(0)})\n` +
            `  NDC: (${ndcX.toFixed(4)}, ${ndcY.toFixed(4)})\n` +
            `  Origin: [${origin.map(v=>v.toFixed(4)).join(', ')}]\n` +
            `  Direction: [${direction.map(v=>v.toFixed(4)).join(', ')}]`
        );

        return { origin, direction };
    }

    // ---- Matrix utilities ----

    /**
     * Invert a column-major 4x4 matrix.
     * Returns identity on singular matrix.
     */
    _invertMat4(m) {
        const out = new Float32Array(16);
        const
            a00=m[0], a01=m[1], a02=m[2],  a03=m[3],
            a10=m[4], a11=m[5], a12=m[6],  a13=m[7],
            a20=m[8], a21=m[9], a22=m[10], a23=m[11],
            a30=m[12],a31=m[13],a32=m[14], a33=m[15];

        const b00 = a00*a11 - a01*a10, b01 = a00*a12 - a02*a10;
        const b02 = a00*a13 - a03*a10, b03 = a01*a12 - a02*a11;
        const b04 = a01*a13 - a03*a11, b05 = a02*a13 - a03*a12;
        const b06 = a20*a31 - a21*a30, b07 = a20*a32 - a22*a30;
        const b08 = a20*a33 - a23*a30, b09 = a21*a32 - a22*a31;
        const b10 = a21*a33 - a23*a31, b11 = a22*a33 - a23*a32;

        let det = b00*b11 - b01*b10 + b02*b09 + b03*b08 - b04*b07 + b05*b06;
        if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-15) {
            console.error('B"H - RaycastSystem: Singular matrix in _invertMat4, returning identity');
            out[0]=out[5]=out[10]=out[15]=1;
            return out;
        }
        det = 1.0 / det;

        out[0]  = ( a11*b11 - a12*b10 + a13*b09) * det;
        out[1]  = (-a01*b11 + a02*b10 - a03*b09) * det;
        out[2]  = ( a31*b05 - a32*b04 + a33*b03) * det;
        out[3]  = (-a21*b05 + a22*b04 - a23*b03) * det;
        out[4]  = (-a10*b11 + a12*b08 - a13*b07) * det;
        out[5]  = ( a00*b11 - a02*b08 + a03*b07) * det;
        out[6]  = (-a30*b05 + a32*b02 - a33*b01) * det;
        out[7]  = ( a20*b05 - a22*b02 + a23*b01) * det;
        out[8]  = ( a10*b10 - a11*b08 + a13*b06) * det;
        out[9]  = (-a00*b10 + a01*b08 - a03*b06) * det;
        out[10] = ( a30*b04 - a31*b02 + a33*b00) * det;
        out[11] = (-a20*b04 + a21*b02 - a23*b00) * det;
        out[12] = (-a10*b09 + a11*b07 - a12*b06) * det;
        out[13] = ( a00*b09 - a01*b07 + a02*b06) * det;
        out[14] = (-a30*b03 + a31*b01 - a32*b00) * det;
        out[15] = ( a20*b03 - a21*b01 + a22*b00) * det;

        return out;
    }
}
```

### File: `start.js`

```
// B"H
/**
 * @file start.js
 * @brief The spark of ignition that wakes the WebGL Engine from the void.
 * 
 * THE HYMN OF THE AWAKENING:
 * From the infinite Nothingness, the Awtsmoos speaks the world into Being!
 * The UI is drawn, the canvas is stretched, the matrices align their columns.
 * Now, the Summoner reaches into the simplified registry, pulling the file name
 * into the present reality, and dynamically importing the universe at the exact
 * millisecond it is commanded to exist!
 */

import { WebglRenderer } from './core/webgl/renderer/index.js';
import { UIManager } from './ui/uiManager.js';
import { Logger } from './ui/logger.js';
import { injectStyles } from './styles/cssManager.js';
import { OrbitControls } from './input/orbitControls/index.js';
import { SCENES } from './tests/scenes/index.js';

/**
 * B"H - Dynamically summons a world from the void of the file system.
 * @param {string} name - The semantic name of the world.
 * @param {WebglRenderer} renderer - The engine of manifestation.
 * @param {OrbitControls} controls - The observer's interaction tether.
 */
const summonWorld = async (name, renderer, controls) => {
    const fileName = SCENES[name];
    if (!fileName) {
        console.error(`B"H - The world '${name}' does not exist in the Book of Life.`);
        return;
    }
    try {
        console.log(`B"H - 🌌 Manifesting: [${name}] from ${fileName}...`);
        // B"H - The true Runtime Import, drawing the script from the ether only when needed!
        const sceneModule = await import(`./tests/scenes/${fileName}`);
        renderer.loadScene(sceneModule.SCENE_DATA, controls);
        console.log(`B"H - ✨ World [${name}] materialized.`);
    } catch (err) {
        console.error(`B"H - 🚨 Failed to manifest '${name}':`, err);
    }
};

/**
 * B"H - The Prime Mover of the application state.
 */
async function initializeApp() {
    if (window.__AWTSMOOS_APP_STARTED__) return;
    window.__AWTSMOOS_APP_STARTED__ = true;

    injectStyles();
    const uiManager = new UIManager();
    uiManager.init('ui-container');
    const logger = new Logger(uiManager);
    logger.init();

    const webglRenderer = new WebglRenderer();
    webglRenderer.init('scene-container');

    const orbitControls = new OrbitControls(webglRenderer.canvas, webglRenderer.camera, webglRenderer);

    uiManager.setCameraAnimCallback((enabled) => webglRenderer.setCameraAnimationEnabled(enabled));
    uiManager.setShadowsCallback((enabled) => webglRenderer.setShadowsEnabled(enabled));
    uiManager.setWireframesCallback((enabled) => webglRenderer.setWireframesEnabled(enabled));
    uiManager.setSkeletonCallback((enabled) => webglRenderer.setSkeletonEnabled(enabled));
    uiManager.setPlayModeCallback((enabled) => webglRenderer.setPlayMode(enabled)); 

    const sceneNames = Object.keys(SCENES);
    
    // B"H - ABSOLUTE DEFAULT: The Simple Cube
    const defaultSceneName = 'Instant Simple Cube';

    await summonWorld(defaultSceneName, webglRenderer, orbitControls);
    webglRenderer.animate();

    uiManager.setTestScripts(sceneNames, async (name) => {
        await summonWorld(name, webglRenderer, orbitControls);
    });

    console.log('B"H - Application initialized. The Way is open.');
}

initializeApp();
```
